runners.spotlight: AW winner over 1m in January; that had seemed like a flash in the pan until a revival in form when overcoming a troubled passage to take third behind the well-fancied Glen Breeze and today's rival Princess Chloe at Limerick; again squeezed for room before keeping on for fifth at Leopardstown last week; fair chance with a little more luck.
runners.comment: Has endured a troubled passage on his last two runs, fair chance with a little more luck

runners.name: Thumama Sands
runners.spotlight: Very hard to take encouragement from three maiden runs; in good hands and may do much better in handicaps.
runners.comment: Hard to take encouragement from three maiden runs, in good hands and may do better now

runners.name: Garryowen Green
runners.spotlight: Weak form in maidens; towards the back in handicaps at Leopardstown and Killarney; 2lb out of the handicap.
runners.comment: Weak form in maidens, towards the back in handicaps at Leopardstown and Killarney, 2lb out

runners.name: Stiorra
runners.spotlight: 11-race maiden; regressive in handicaps for the Slattery team last season; down from a peak of 72 to a modest 47 now; possible that a change of scene will do the trick; Conor O'Dwyer tries a new headgear combination.
runners.comment: Has been regressive, possible that a change of scene will do the trick, much reduced mark

runners.name: Incredible Army
runners.spotlight: Sprang a surprise in a three-runner rated race at Dundalk in February (6f); has beaten few rivals in three runs since; some reasons to be hopeful are a recent gelding operation, a first run in 0-60 company and the presence of Browne McMonagle in the saddle for the first time.
runners.comment: Sprang a surprise in a three-runner AW rated race; well beaten three times since

runners.name: Sands Castle
runners.spotlight: Fourth here on seasonal return in April (1m, soft) and back to form on second handicap start when staying on to be runner-up to subsequent winner Rodeo Drive at Ballinrobe (1m2f, yielding); well beaten at Killarney last time when trying 1m4f for the first time; best form on easier ground.
runners.comment: Fourth here in April and was a good second on pneultimate; best form on easier ground

runners.name: Brains
runners.spotlight: Veteran winner of 14 races (11 on AW); shaped well in his four races this season, the latest when a 4.5l fifth of 15 at Roscommon (7.5f, good), weakening late on; should go well once again.
runners.comment: 14-time veteran winner has shaped well in his four races this season; can go well again

runners.name: Jackandthefox
runners.spotlight: Winless from 23 starts; ran his best race on turf in this race (good) last year when a 1.5l third off 7lb higher; satisfactory efforts at Fairyhouse over 6f in his last two runs; not ruled out, but drawn wide.
runners.comment: 0-23 but ran best race on turf in this race last year when third off 7lb higher

runners.name: Usuario Amigo
runners.spotlight: Sole win came in a Brighton maiden in September 2024; has been regressive over various trips this season; not his worst effort when mid-field in a Killarney claimer (1m, good) last time; others preferred.
runners.comment: Sole win came in a 2024 m'den; regressive this season

runners.name: Dynamic Force
runners.spotlight: Four-time winner but last win came in a claimer in 2024; some satisfactory efforts this season and the best of them came last time at Leopardstown (7f, good) when taking the runner-up spot; in the mix.
runners.comment: Satisfactory efforts this season and the best of them came last time when second

runners.name: Miqdaad
runners.spotlight: AW maiden winner in 2024; one good run last year, a 0.5l second of 13 at Limerick in July; poor return at Fairyhouse in May (6f, good); needs to improve hugely on that.
runners.comment: Just one good run last term and needs to improve hugely on his poor seasonal return

runners.name: Beau Army
runners.spotlight: Won back-to-back handicaps on the AW at Dundalk in November/January over 6f/7f, the latter off a mark of 45; her 3.75l third at Killarney (1m, good) last time was her best effort on turf; 3lb wrong but she could find enough improvement in first-time cheekpieces.
runners.comment: Dual AW winner ran her best race on turf last time when third; 3lb wrong but could go well

runners.name: Darwin's Angel
runners.spotlight: Best run for previous yard came when fourth in a Down Royal nursery off 61 in September; struggled in five starts for new connections, including when beaten 22l at Naas earlier this month.
runners.comment: Struggled in five starts for new connections inc' when beaten 22l last time

runners.name: Eichan San
runners.spotlight: Has failed to reach the first three in 11 attempts; has shown his best form this season in two Curragh outings; well beaten at Leopardstown last time (7f, good); blinkers go on now.
runners.comment: Failed to reach first three in 11 attempts; well beaten last time

runners.name: Glen Breeze
runners.spotlight: Placed in two of his previous three starts against older horses before gaining a first win back against his own age group at Limerick last time (6.5f, good); up 9lb for that win, but should continue to give a good account of himself; badly drawn, though.
runners.comment: Up 9lb for his win last time and drawn wide but can go well

runners.name: Nosmokewithoutfire
runners.spotlight: Didn't improve for the switch to handicaps at Bellewstown (1m, good) when 19.5l behind the winner; dual headgear is reached for in the search for more.
runners.comment: Didn't improve for switch to h'caps last time; new headgear goes on
runners.owner: Ms Denise McCourt & Stephen Sweeney & Maire Bailey

runners.name: Snap Decision
runners.spotlight: Made a decent handicap debut at Roscommon in June when slowly away before keeping on into sixth over an extended 7f; never on terms at Limerick last time (6.5f, good); others more likely.
runners.comment: Decent h'cap debut but lesser effort last time; others more likely.

runners.name: Tariff
runners.spotlight: Beaten by 29l on stable debut at Bellewstown when 8lb out of the weights; this is a more suitable leve,l but others appeal more despite the first-time hood.
runners.comment: Beaten 29l on stable debut when 8lb wrong; this more suitable but others preferred

runners.name: Leannespour
runners.spotlight: Towards the rear in all three maidens, the latter two at triple-figure prices; may improve for handicaps now.
runners.comment: Towards rear in all three m'dens; could improve for h'caps

runners.name: The Blue Panther
runners.spotlight: Five career wins, the last two coming at Listowel; best run this term came last month at Roscommon (7.5f, good) when a never-nearer fourth; didn't progress at Killarney last time (1m, good) when keen.
runners.comment: Best run this term was a never nearer fourth on penultimate; didn't progress last time
runners.owner: Ms Julianne McNally & Colette McNally & D McNally

races.race_name: John Fleming Irish EBF Marble City Stakes (Listed Race)

runners.name: Amadeus Mozart
runners.spotlight: Won a 7f Curragh maiden last June in his only race as a 2yo; twice second in small-field races but was beginning to look limited until producing a smart display to take second in the 1m2f Golden Gates Stakes (Handicap) at Royal Ascot; overtook Nil Bua Gan Dua in the closing stages and can emerge best in the rematch.
runners.comment: Won at two, best of three seconds this season in a Royal Ascot handicap. strong chance
runners.owner: Michael Tabor & Derrick Smith & Mrs John Magnier

runners.name: Nil Bua Gan Dua
runners.spotlight: Highly tried in Pattern races as a juvenile; off the mark when making all over an extended 1m2f at Roscommon on seasonal debut this term; only 1 3/4l behind the stronger-finishing Amadeus Mozart when fourth of 16 on handicap debut at Royal Ascot (1m2f, good to firm); proved vulnerable over a longer trip in the 1m5f Bahrain Trophy at Newmarket; cheekpieces on now.
runners.comment: Highly tried as a juvenile, closely matched with Amadeus Mozart on Royal Ascot running
runners.owner: A K Whelan & Reeves Thoroughbred Racing

runners.name: Believed
runners.spotlight: Half-sister to Melbourne Cup winner Gold Trip; second to the subsequent Irish Oaks winner Johanna Walsh over 1m2f at Leopardstown in May after making her debut at Dundalk in April; returned to AW to record a wide-margin maiden win; held her own when a fine third in Royal Ascot's King George V Stakes (Handicap); further progress likely.
runners.comment: Wide-margin AW maiden winner, fine effort when third in a 1m4f Royal Ascot handicap

runners.name: Saga Gaga
runners.spotlight: Course maiden winner on her second start; deserves a shot at this after a Killarney handicap win; progressive filly; needs to find extra to trouble a trio with Royal Ascot handicap form.
runners.comment: Course maiden winner and Killarney handicap scorer, progressive filly, needs to find extra

runners.name: Camino Vino
runners.spotlight: Beat an 86-rated previous winner in a 1m contest at Dundalk in December on her only juvenile start; set a tough task in a fillies' Group 3 event at Navan on return; struggled in a valuable race at this venue last time; up against it.
runners.comment: AW winner at two, ran in a Group 3 on return, struggled in a valuable race at this venue

runners.name: Vauntingly
runners.spotlight: Deserved her breakthrough win at Killarney after three consecutive placed efforts; can prove useful in a lower grade; much inferior to her two stablemates on figures.
runners.comment: Deserved her breakthrough win at Killarney, inferior to her two stablemates on figures

runners.name: Echo Inferno
runners.spotlight: Handed a rating of 88 after a 1m5f maiden win at Leopardstown on his third outing; will need to improve to feature in a race of this standard.
runners.comment: Handed a rating of 88 after a 1m5f maiden win, will need to improve to feature here

races.race_name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Fillies Maiden

runners.name: Wearing Stars
runners.spotlight: Twice placed over 6f on AW late last year; fourth in 5f Cork maiden on reappearance; never in contention on handicap debut; better when stepped up to 7f in a Down Royal maiden; finished 1 1/4l behind Elmakaya at Naas; more exposed than that rival, good place chance all the same.
runners.comment: Finished 1 1/4l behind Elmakaya at Naas, more exposed than that rival, good place chance

runners.name: Elmakaya
runners.spotlight: Wootton Bassett filly made some late headway on debut at Leopardstown; perhaps a little unlucky not to peg back a front-running 50-1 chance at Naas in May; confirmed maiden-winning potential with third of 19 at the same venue; seems likely to uphold form with the more exposed Wearing Stars who took fourth place
runners.comment: Placed in two Naas maidens over this trip; good chance of a breakthrough win here
runners.owner: Exors Of The Late H H Aga Khan

runners.name: Vishaya
runners.spotlight: Placed in two AW maidens early this year; modest run on turf debut in 1m Naas maiden (good); narrowly denied by in-form rival off 74 on handicap debut at Killarney 12 days ago; officially rated 7lb inferior to Elmakaya.
runners.comment: Handicap mark is about right, judged on Killarney second, rated 7lb inferior to Elmakaya

runners.name: Star Of Beauty
runners.spotlight: Rated 77; some solid efforts in defeat; bounced back from a disappointing handicap run at the Curragh when second in a claimer at Roscommon and has continued to show similar form in maidens; needs to raise her game a notch.
runners.comment: Placed in four of her eight starts, well exposed, needs to raise her game a notch
runners.owner: David K Kelly & Mrs Pauline Condon

runners.name: Serendipia
runners.spotlight: Lovely pedigree (dam won a Group 1); has not yet shown enough to suggest she is a likely maiden winner.
runners.comment: Lovely pedigree, has not yet shown enough to suggest she is a likely maiden winner

runners.name: Whatsin The Stars
runners.spotlight: Second foal; half-sister by Starman to a three-time minor winner; dam, by War Command, an unraced half-sister to two useful winners; fitted with cheekpieces for debut.
runners.comment: Half-sister by Starman to a three-time minor winner, fitted with cheekpieces for debut

runners.name: Ballysax Boo
runners.spotlight: Cheap yearling; fifth foal; half-sister by Bobby's Kitten to two winners who stayed further than this; dam 7f AW winner.
runners.comment: Cheap yearling. half-sister by Bobby's Kitten to two winners who stayed further than this

runners.name: Churchfield Lady
runners.spotlight: Has shown little in two runs over an extended 1m2f; cheekpieces tried now by top trainer; may improve but best watched until she shows a spark of promise.
runners.comment: No obvious promise in two runs over an extended 1m2f, cheekpieces tried, best watched

runners.name: Hello Stacia
runners.spotlight: Soundly beaten in third behind a high-class Joseph O'Brien-trained runner at Limerick on debut; likely to need more experience.
runners.comment: Soundly beaten in third at Limerick on debut, likely to need more experience

runners.name: Mrs Lady Bella
runners.spotlight: Has struggled in two races at Limerick; 5 1/2l behind Hello Stacia on the second occasion.
runners.comment: Has struggled in two races at Limerick, 5 1/2l behind Hello Stacia on the second occasion

runners.name: Blue Orquidea
runners.spotlight: Has changed stable since a fair fifth of 16 on debut at Limerick; open to improvement; likely to need more experience.
runners.comment: Has changed stable since a fair fifth of 16 on debut at Limerick, open to improvement

runners.name: Walls Cross
runners.spotlight: Has beaten just a couple of rivals in each of two 1m4f starts; can be ruled out in this clash with the younger generation.
runners.comment: Has beaten just a couple of rivals in each of two 1m4f starts, can be ruled out

runners.name: Duchess Of Kenli
runners.spotlight: Half-sister to the smart Princess Child who was a Group 3 winner for this stable last season; ran once on AW last season; champion jockey prefers Vishaya.
runners.comment: Half-sister to the smart Princess Child, ran once at two, champion jockey prefers Vishaya

runners.name: Hambelton
runners.spotlight: Never saw another rival when making all at Cork (1m, good) to win by 3l; raised 10lb for that but almost repeated the dose at York two weeks ago when headed late on into second (1m, good to firm); raised another 4lb now, but he's thriving and is firmly in the mix.
runners.comment: Made all to win at Cork and almost repeated the trick last time; thriving and in the mix

runners.name: Harana
runners.spotlight: Shed the maiden tag at the fourth attempt in a Ballinrobe maiden in June (9.5f, yielding); ran respectably when fifth in her second handicap start in a valuable Leopardstown contest 16 days ago (1m1f, good); dropped 1lb but would probably like to see some rain.
runners.comment: Shed maiden tag on penultimate; respectable fifth in a handicap latest; prefers softer
runners.owner: Exors Of The Late H H Aga Khan

runners.name: Liberation Date
runners.spotlight: Sole win came in an AW 7f maiden at Dundalk in December (7f); had the run of the race in a Curragh premier handicap (1m1f, good) last time but it was still a career-best effort in third; interestingly, Browne McMonagle takes over now.
runners.comment: Career-best effort came when third in a premier h'cap latest; champion jockey rides now

runners.name: Ocean Manifest
runners.spotlight: Two-time AW winner; yet to score on turf but hasn't run badly at times; posted an underwhelming effort at Leopardstown (1m, good) last time returning from a break when 6.5l behind the winner Frank Pickle; needs to improve.
runners.comment: Dual AW winner was 6.5l behind Frank Pickle back from a break latest; must improve
runners.owner: J Kirkland & Mrs J M Ryan

runners.name: Red Hugh O'Donnell
runners.spotlight: Both wins have come over 1m at Killarney; won his maiden there last summer (yielding to soft) and returned there a year later to record a first handicap success (good) off 68 last time; not certain to back it up all the same.
runners.comment: Both wins came over 1m at Killarney inc' latest; up 6lb and not certain to back it up

runners.name: Zaraahmando
runners.spotlight: 3-18 on turf; low-key start to this campaign, but back on song in his latest two runs over 1m at Leopardstown; beaten a neck there in June off 69 and was a 2.25l third behind Frank Pickle off 73 last time; there might be a few better handicapped than him, but he's in form.
runners.comment: Good runs over 1m at Leopardstown twice recently; others may be better handicapped

runners.name: No More Porter
runners.spotlight: All three wins have been gained at the Curragh and a large portion of his places too; good second over 1m at his favoured venue last month and took that good form on tour to Killarney (1m, good) last time when just 0.75l behind the winner Red Hugh O'Donnell; up 3lb for that effort, but a repeat would see him thereabouts.
runners.comment: Ran well when 0.75l behind Red Hugh O'Donnell at Killarney last time; thereabouts

runners.name: Frank Pickle
runners.spotlight: Made the breakthrough at the tenth time of asking at Leopardstown (1m, good) when taking advantage of being at the front of affairs to win by 0.75l, with a couple of these behind; up 7lb and has his chance.
runners.comment: Ridden prominently to shed maiden tag latest; up 7lb and has his chance again

runners.name: Snow Princess
runners.spotlight: Creditable efforts in her opening two AW maidens and her best effort came on the switch to turf at Leopardstown last time when a 6.5l third of 14 (1m, yielding to soft); not totally ruled out on handicap bow.
runners.comment: Creditable efforts in maidens and best effort came on switch to turf when third latest

runners.name: Yquem
runners.spotlight: Took a big step forward from her stable debut when beating Nibras Rainbow by 3.5l at Leopardstown in June (1m1f, good to firm); ran to the same level in a similar contest last time when 1l third to Nibras Rainbow off 10lb higher; shortlisted.
runners.comment: Won easily at Leopardstown and ran to same level when third off 10lb higher next time

runners.name: Burford Beauty
runners.spotlight: Best handicap display came at Down Royal in May when third over 7f; didn't reproduce that at Leopardstown 16 days ago, when tenth of 22 and 5.25l behind Yquem; likely capable of better.
runners.comment: Best h'cap run when third on penultimate; didn't reproduce when 5.25l behind Yquem latest

runners.name: Duchess Anne
runners.spotlight: Positive fourth over 1m at Naas last time (good) when ahead of Morning Approach and Master Garvey; that came following a 275-day break, so she's entitled to improve.
runners.comment: Positive fourth last time; came after a 275-day break so entitled to improve

runners.name: Deuteronomy
runners.spotlight: Gained a fourth career win with a 22-1 success at Cork in May in testing conditions; not so good since on faster ground, finished in midfield at Killarney over an extended 1m3f last time; others more likely.
runners.comment: Added fourth win in May in testing conditions. but not as good since on better ground

runners.name: Shahada Ace
runners.spotlight: Easily won a Tipperary handicap off 51 last summer (7.5f, good); yet to make an impact in six outings this season.
runners.comment: Easily won off 51 at Tipperary last summer; yet to make an impact in six outings this term

runners.name: Hexagonal
runners.spotlight: Maiden produced back-to-back solid runs at Ballinrobe and the Curragh earlier this season; has failed to reach the same standard in last four starts; too keen when 13l behind the winner at Killarney (1m, good) latest.
runners.comment: M'den posted back-to-back solid efforts earlier in the season, but not same standard since

runners.name: Master Garvey
runners.spotlight: 1-35 on turf; behind a couple of these when 11th of 18 at Naas (1m, good) last time; blinkers replace the previously-worn visor, but others more likely.
runners.comment: 1-35 on turf and behind a couple of these at Naas last time; others more likely
runners.owner: Patrick M O'Brien/Larry Murray/Richard W Walsh/Derek Cummins

runners.name: Georg Zhukov
runners.spotlight: Made a flying start to his career with this yard when successful over 1m on stable debut on AW off 51 in January in a first-time hood; well below that level in two subsequent runs at Dundalk, and his two recent efforts over hurdles were not amazing either.
runners.comment: Successful stable debut off 51 on AW in Jan'; way below that level since inc' over hurdles

runners.name: Lady Luck
runners.spotlight: Yet to place from 11 starts; okay sixths in her last two runs; more needed.
runners.comment: Yet to place from 11 starts; okay sixths in her last two runs; more needed

runners.name: Haughty
runners.spotlight: Her win came in a 1m Salisbury handicap back in 2023; two runs for new yard were not too encouraging.
runners.comment: Sole win came in 2023; two runs for new yard not too encouraging

runners.name: Magna Gee Gee
runners.spotlight: Doubled his tally and gained a first turf win when successful by a head over an extended 1m4f at Limerick two weeks ago (good); the top four finished in a heap that day so he's up just 1lb; drops back to his AW winning trip; thereabouts once again.
runners.comment: Got first turf win last time; top four finished in a heap and he's up just 1lb

runners.name: Jazz Dreamers
runners.spotlight: Three-time turf winner from 33 starts but nothing since 2023; recent form not too encouraging, behind a couple of these in eighth at Leopardstown last time (1m1f, good); 4lb wrong.
runners.comment: No wins since 2023 and recent form not too encouraging; 4lb wrong.
runners.owner: Mrs Helen Butler & Mrs Bernadette Fahey & Seamus Fahey

runners.name: Morning Approach
runners.spotlight: 1-43 on turf; struggled on the AW last winter; made an okay return to turf at Roscommon when fifth (7.5f, good) but was very poor next time over 1m here; bounced back with a good sixth at Leopardstown next time (1m1f, good); another poor run at Naas three days ago; hard to trust.
runners.comment: 1-43 on turf and form in and out this season without ever threatening to win

runners.name: Puppet Master
runners.spotlight: Ex-Ballydoyle; won Lingfield Derby Trial last year but well held in Irish Derby and Irish St Leger; bought for 78,000gns and has been soundly beaten in two hurdle races and a Curragh Listed contest for new yard; top rated of these, but others bring more compelling recent form.
runners.comment: Listed winner is the top-rated of these but others have better recent form

runners.name: Spicy Margarita
runners.spotlight: One of two for trainer; sole success came in a 3yo Dundalk maiden early last year; didn't run a bad race in a Curragh Listed contest in June when just 1.75l behind the winner (1m, good); out of her depth in a Curragh Group 3 last week; has the rating to be involved at this level.
runners.comment: Didn't run badly in a listed race in June; has the rating to be involved at this level
runners.owner: AMO Racing Limited & Giselle De Aguiar

runners.name: Leopold The First
runners.spotlight: Eight-race maiden has finished second in five of his races, including his last four; good effort in a four-runner C&D race on just his second turf run last time when 1.5l behind Trustyourinstinct, who has since won a Group 2; would receive 8lb from Summer Is Tomorrow in a handicap, so has work to do but he's consistent.
runners.comment: M'den would receive 8lb from Summer Is Tomorrow in a h'cap but he's consistent

runners.name: Summer Is Tomorrow
runners.spotlight: Nicely treated by race conditions and has run good races in second in his last two starts; beaten just a neck in a premier handicap at the Curragh in June (1m1f, good); failed to justify 11-10 favouritism at Navan last time when going down by a head; leading chance again.
runners.comment: Nicely treated by race conditions and good seconds last twice; leading chance

runners.name: Goddess Of War
runners.spotlight: By champion sire in South Africa, Vercingetorix; dam South African 5.5f-1m2f winner (inc 2yo/Grade 1; RPR 101); there are easier races in which to debut but worth a market check.
runners.comment: By champion sire in SA; dam Grade 1 winner (RPR 101); worth a market check

runners.name: Hollys Graces
runners.spotlight: Lightly-raced 4yo won a 7f AW maiden on debut in September 2024; well held in four runs last year in good-class company; always behind returned to Dundalk last time (1m4f); needs to bring more in first-time blinkers and treated poorly at weights.
runners.comment: Always behind back on AW latest; treated poorly at the weights

runners.name: Benevento
runners.spotlight: Useful 2yo in Britain (Listed 7f winner) and ran some fair races in the face of stiff tasks as a 3yo; returned from a 217-day absence at Lingfield on AW (7f, 15-8 fav) in February, having been gelded, but folded quickly; makes stable debut now, but needs to return to his best to win in a contest where others are treated slightly better by race conditions.
runners.comment: Listed winning 2yo was a disappointing fav' in final British start; needs to bring best

runners.name: Al Maslool
runners.spotlight: No wins in seven but still went off odds-on for his second crack at a handicap last time at Nottingham (1m2f, good to firm) where a slow start did him no favours in a steadily run race; that wasn't the first time he's been slowly away so that's a concern around here, but the ability is there.
runners.comment: 0-7 and can start slowly, as last time; however, ability is there to win off this mark

runners.name: Grey Fable
runners.spotlight: Victory in this two years ago is one of two course wins; dangerously treated if revived by a return to this venue and he did win on the AW in May.
runners.comment: Victory in this two years ago one of two course wins; dangerously treated if back on song

runners.name: Sisterandbrother
runners.spotlight: This year's four wins have been in Class 6s but it was very clearcut at Beverley (1m4f, good to form) three weeks ago when the cheekpieces were back on; he's still fairly treated off 4lb higher.
runners.comment: This year's four wins have been in Class 6s but it was very clearcut at Beverley latest

runners.name: Mr Moonshine
runners.spotlight: Only had seven races and two since gelded; first try over as far as 1m3f when nosed out at Hamilton (good) two weeks ago; considered.
runners.comment: First try over as far as 1m3f when nosed out at Hamilton (good) two weeks ago

runners.name: Kindly Queen
runners.spotlight: Left Ralph Beckett for 24,000gns and as a seven-race maiden; does have competitive form off this mark, including last time when tried in cheekpieces (had worn blinkers in two previous races); hard to discount.
runners.comment: Ex-Beckett; seven-race maiden but has competitive form off this mark

runners.name: Risk Averse Rebel
runners.spotlight: Tailed off in a maiden here last year; respectable efforts over 1m4f at Wolverhampton last month but looks better on the AW and he does have his quirks.
runners.comment: Ten-race maiden with ability; has his quirks and might be better on the AW

runners.name: Return With Gold
runners.spotlight: 1m2f/1m3f wins on the AW; showed little in two runs over hurdles before returning from a break and wind surgery with a fourth of ten at Southwell in January; now back from another break, others are safer.
runners.comment: Both wins have been on the AW and current wellbeing is an issue

runners.name: Ottoman
runners.spotlight: Front-running tactics in the new blinkers didn't work two runs ago but he had cover before coming home 7l clear at Leicester 11 days ago (1m4f, good to firm); up 7lb but clear claims should he deliver something similar.
runners.comment: Easy winner at Leicester and clear claims should he deliver something similar

runners.name: Imperial Trooper
runners.spotlight: Novice win in 2024 remains his sole win in 18 Flat races and he has performed poorly in his two previous visits here; well-held third over hurdles last week; not overly appealing.
runners.comment: Novice win in 2024 his sole win in 18 Flat races; ordinary effort over hurdles last week

runners.name: Yokkell
runners.spotlight: Multiple winner who took advantage of her much reduced mark when justifying favouritism at Bath (extended 1m3f, firm); entitled to go well again off 4lb higher; ran okay in one or her two previous visits here.
runners.comment: Took advantage of her much reduced mark when justifying favouritism at Bath

runners.name: Cool Molly
runners.spotlight: Four AW wins from 5f to 7f; good sixth of 12 at York (6f, good) before scuppered by the widest stall over 7f here four weeks ago; better boxed this afternoon and she likes to be handy in her races; interesting.
runners.comment: AW wins; good run at York before scuppered by a wide stall here four weeks ago

runners.name: Highland Olly
runners.spotlight: Win number three in seven starts this year when always prominent and collecting by a length at Beverley (7.4f); that was in a good time and he's only 2lb higher; clear claims from a good draw.
runners.comment: Won in a good time at Beverley and only 2lb higher here; clear claims from a good draw

runners.name: Collecting Coin
runners.spotlight: Competitive in some of his handicaps in Ireland after winning a 7f maiden at Galway a year ago; left Jessica Harrington for 33,000gns; should pay his way for new connections off this sort of mark.
runners.comment: Competitive in 7f/1m handicaps in Ireland; recently joined this yard for 33,000gns

runners.name: Quiet Resolve
runners.spotlight: No further progress since his successful yard debut over Hamilton's extended 1m in May and others look on better terms with the handicapper.
runners.comment: A winner in May but three defeats since and others look better handicapped

runners.name: Giant
runners.spotlight: Three-time AW winner who is 0-12 on turf but was very competitive in his last two races here, beaten a short head (7f) and then faring best of those who chased a strong pace two weeks ago (C&D); firmly in the mix.
runners.comment: Short-headed here before finishing third when he did well after chasing a strong pace

runners.name: Supreme Clarets
runners.spotlight: No wins in 11 but denied by a neck in his last two races, both over 7f at Musselburgh and Carlisle; if handling this track then should feature off an untouched mark.
runners.comment: No wins in 11 but denied by a neck in his last two races and mark untouched

runners.name: Woodstock
runners.spotlight: Unraced here; arrives in a fair run of form and although only four ran when second at Catterick (7f, good to firm; new visor), the winner was an unexposed 3yo; likely to have some say from the inside stall.
runners.comment: Only four ran when second last time but the winner was an unexposed 3yo

runners.name: Law Of Design
runners.spotlight: Won a four-runner novice at Ascot (7f, soft) in September 2024; well handicapped on some of his form but needs to rediscover a spark.
runners.comment: Well handicapped on some of his form but needs to rediscover some spark

races.race_name: IRE Incentive, It Pays To Buy Irish Maiden Stakes (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)

runners.name: Velociraptor
runners.spotlight: 38,000gns yearling; Lope Y Fernandez half-brother to five winners; shaped with considerable promise when third at Newmarket in what is always a strong maiden (7f, good to firm); wasn't helped by his track position, either; hard to beat.
runners.comment: Considerable promise when third at Newmarket in what is always a strong maiden

runners.name: Sea Idol
runners.spotlight: Lengthy odds for both his runs over 7f on the AW; they finished in a heap when he went close at Southwell and he was outpaced when it mattered at Lingfield; however, there are positives to take from those efforts and he surely has more to offer.
runners.comment: Positives to take from his first two efforts and he surely has more to offer

runners.name: Storm Blade
runners.spotlight: Well related; looks to have been learning on the job and again shaped encouragingly when beaten 5l in a useful 7f novice at Sandown (good); has to improve on that but he will at some stage.
runners.comment: Again shaped encouragingly when beaten 5l in a useful 7f novice at Sandown

runners.name: Parry Green
runners.spotlight: 250-1 when a tailed-off last over 7f at Carlisle a month ago.
runners.comment: 250-1 when a tailed-off last over 7f at Carlisle a month ago

runners.name: Katie's Cavalier
runners.spotlight: Three defeats include a seller and he's earned himself a low handicap mark; now gelded.
runners.comment: Three defeats include a seller and he's earned himself a low handicap mark; now gelded

runners.name: Royal Titan
runners.spotlight: £62,000 (breeze-up) 2yo; doesn't look an imminent winner after his first two efforts and probably one for handicaps.
runners.comment: Doesn't look an imminent winner after his first two efforts and probably one for handicaps

runners.name: Calico Blue
runners.spotlight: Dual C&D novice winner last season and his handicap form this year is strong, finishing fourth in the Palace Of Holyroodhouse at Royal Ascot (5f, good to firm) before returning to 6f to finish a neck second of 13 to Jazl in a traditionally hot race at the Newmarket July meeting (good to firm again); a 2lb nudge doesn't look enough to stop him from a good draw.
runners.comment: Dual C&D winner last year and boasts notably strong handicap form this time round

runners.name: Tricky Tel
runners.spotlight: Third Chester success when beating older horses over 5f (good to soft; has won on good to firm) last month; never involved behind Calico Blue in the Palace Of Holyroodhouse at Royal Ascot since but his 1131 course record suggests a much better run is likely now.
runners.comment: No impact at Royal Ascot but has Chester record of 1131; has to merit respect

runners.name: Postmodern
runners.spotlight: Impressive on debut at Yarmouth (6f, good to firm) last May and tapped back into that promise when short-headed in a handicap at Meydan (6f, good) in March (gelded after); raced too freely and weakened from prominence in top 3yo handicap at York (6f, good) on British return six weeks ago; hopefully the addition of a hood helps him to settle better this time.
runners.comment: Too free in 6f handicap at York in June but may fare better if hood helps him to settle

runners.name: Grasmere Boy
runners.spotlight: Going the right way, making it 2-2 since dropping to 6f when seeing off six rivals on course handicap debut (good) a fortnight ago; has the potential for better again but he was able to control that race from the front from the inside stall and hasn't fared so well with the draw this time.
runners.comment: Dominated a C&D handicap two weeks ago but 6lb higher now and drawn wider than ideal

runners.name: Stargazed
runners.spotlight: Her reappearance second of 17 at the York Dante meeting (good) is strong form but she's failed to back it up twice since; races beyond 5f for the first time now; drawn widest.
runners.comment: Excellent second on York return but hasn't backed it up twice since; first run beyond 5f

runners.name: Ray Mon Dough
runners.spotlight: Made all for wide-margin win on his debut at Lingfield (AW) in November and he was back around that sort of form when second to the very promising Behike (second in strong Ascot handicap recently) in good-ground novice there (also 6f) in May; interesting runner.
runners.comment: Made all for AW win last year; chased home very promising sort on turf latest; interesting

runners.name: Boston Dan
runners.spotlight: Good second in sales and Listed races over 6f at York during his 2yo campaign but not in anything like the same form this term; sold out of the Richard & Peter Fahey stable for 26,000gns since his latest start four weeks ago.
runners.comment: Useful 2yo but has struggled this year; hopes pinned on change of yard sparking a revival

runners.name: Aces Wild
runners.spotlight: Won two Class 5s before a strong-finishing third at this level here last time having been last at one point; however, stall 11 could be a killer.
runners.comment: Good run here last time having been last at one point; has a desperate draw

runners.name: Al Hussar
runners.spotlight: Beat a big field at Thirsk in May and ran pretty well here next time from stall 9 in a Class 3; backed that up with another competitive show and he got himself too far back at York last time; considered.
runners.comment: In good form, runs this track well and he got too far back last time at York

runners.name: Miraculous
runners.spotlight: Course winner who should be well handicapped now but stall 9 won't make life easy.
runners.comment: Course winner who should be well handicapped now but stall 9 won't make life easy

runners.name: Spendmore Lane
runners.spotlight: Last run was underwhelming but she was performing well prior to that in 5f/6f handicaps; on the downside, she's drawn quite wide on her first visit to this track.
runners.comment: Has been running well but she's drawn quite wide on her first visit to this track

runners.name: Right And Exact
runners.spotlight: 4yo with only six races behind him and has gone 2-3 in handicaps with narrow verdicts at Thirsk and Musselburgh (again 5f, good); essentially 5lb higher than last time as Zak Wheatley claimed 3lb that day, but he's got a good draw and first-time headgear; respected.
runners.comment: He's gone 2-3 in handicaps; up the weights but well drawn and in new headgear

runners.name: Copper Knight
runners.spotlight: Admirable veteran who had a wicked draw in a C&D handicap last month that he'd won three times before; better boxed this time and there was much to like about his previous effort at Thirsk; considered.
runners.comment: Admirable veteran always respected around here; better boxed than last time

runners.name: Henrythenate
runners.spotlight: Three 5f wins on AW for previous yards; ran well for a long way over C&D in May on debut for this stable and faced a tough task at Epsom's Derby meeting; couldn't dismiss from his handy draw.
runners.comment: Ran well for a long way over C&D in May and he faced a tough task at Epsom

runners.name: Secret Mistral
runners.spotlight: Made all from stall 2 here a fortnight ago under Myla Coppins; she's up in class and the weights (raised 6lb), while stall 7 isn't absolutely ideal.
runners.comment: She's up in class and the weights (raised 6lb), while stall 7 isn't absolutely ideal

runners.name: Master Of My Fate
runners.spotlight: Has won twice on the AW since finishing well held in this 12 months ago but hasn't offered all that much in his last three races.
runners.comment: Well held in this 12 months ago and hasn't offered all that much in his last three races
runners.owner: Ms Janelle Cao, Ross Harmon & Partner

runners.name: Rosenpur
runners.spotlight: All six wins have been here and at Wolverhampton, including this race 12 months ago when 6lb lower; close fourth here last time when drawn wide but in a smaller field than today and now he's out in stall 12; cheekpieces tried last time are removed.
runners.comment: Always a force to be reckoned with here but stall 12 asks some serious questions

runners.name: Grandlad
runners.spotlight: All wins have been at 5f, the latest by a head at Nottingham in April (1lb lower); disappointing at Newmarket but ran poorly on his previous visit there; could bounce back from a handy draw.
runners.comment: 1lb higher than for his win in April; 6th at Newmarket but that might not be his track

runners.name: Break The Bank
runners.spotlight: Winning miler for Andrew Balding; quiet stable debut but has perked up for blinkers, going close at Ayr (1m2f) and Hamilton (8.3f); kept on well last time, suggesting this return to further will benefit.
runners.comment: Two near misses since the blinkers went on and this return to further will benefit

runners.name: Secret Beach
runners.spotlight: Two 1m4f wins for Ben Brookhouse last year; hasn't seriously threatened back on the Flat for current yard (best effort was here in May) and ideally wants further.
runners.comment: Both wins and best form has been at 1m4f, so ideally wants further

runners.name: Seven Sisters
runners.spotlight: Kingman filly who is a half-sister to the high-class Barney Roy; after two near misses (7f/8.6f) she got off the mark by a neck in a small-field 1m2f novice at Doncaster (good to firm); mixed messages as to the strength of that form but she brings potential into handicaps.
runners.comment: Debatable what she beat at Doncaster but brings potential into handicaps

runners.name: Parlando
runners.spotlight: Capable handicapper off this mark but has gone badly off the boil in last three races, admittedly in higher grades; still has a bit to prove now and failed to fire on his previous visit here.
runners.comment: Has gone badly off the boil in last three races, admittedly in higher grades

runners.name: Lexington Jet
runners.spotlight: Front-runner who went off too fast for his own good over the extended 7f here two weeks ago and folded, which was also the case in his two previous runs; on a handy mark if he did get any freedom up front, though stamina doubts remain over quite this far.
runners.comment: Front-runner on a handy mark but stamina doubts remain over quite this far

runners.name: Nolton Cross
runners.spotlight: 6-24 on AW but 0-13 on turf; returned to form when second over C&D (good; Class 3) two weeks ago but he dictated steady fractions from the front and it probably flatters him; still commands some attention.
runners.comment: Runner-up here last time but he dictated steady fractions from the front

runners.name: Duc De Kent
runners.spotlight: French turf/AW winner (7.5f/1m2f) early in 2023; choppy waters afterwards and has been absent since finishing tailed off in the Chester Plate in May 2024.
runners.comment: Has been absent since finishing tailed off in the Chester Plate in May 2024

races.race_name: Family Fun Day On 2nd August Handicap

runners.name: Far Too Fizzy
runners.spotlight: Both wins over 6f but he's quick and well drawn for a front-runner; however, has been confined to the AW since contesting two turf maidens at the start of his career (one here); if handling the surface he might run well.
runners.comment: Better known for AW form but lightly raced on turf; well drawn for a pacey one

runners.name: Knicks
runners.spotlight: 8lb lower than when beaten a head in a division of this last year; missed the kick here two weeks ago but nothing finished better and he looks ready to win again.
runners.comment: Missed the kick here last time but nothing finished better and looks ready to win again

runners.name: Keldeo
runners.spotlight: Five-time turf winner but unraced here; had the cheekpieces back on when always close up to finish second at Beverley last time out; same mark and no excuses on the draw front.
runners.comment: Second at Beverley latest; same mark and no excuses on the draw front
runners.owner: Ownaracehorse, O Pears and T&T Racing Ltd

runners.name: Over Spiced
runners.spotlight: Consistent 4yo who was close up in a higher grade at Sandown before another placed effort at Newbury; however, she's got the worst of the draw and is handicapped about right.
runners.comment: Running well but she's got the worst of the draw and is handicapped about right

runners.name: Beauzon
runners.spotlight: Rattled off a seven-timer on the AW earlier this year; rated lower on turf but went off 40-1 here recently on his return from a break and trailed in last.
runners.comment: Went off 40-1 here recently on his return from a break and trailed in last

runners.name: Harry Mole
runners.spotlight: Well drawn and was never far away when runner-up at Thirsk and Bath (both at 5f); lightly raced and may well improve some more; this will be a new experience but he enters the reckoning.
runners.comment: Well drawn and was never far away when runner-up at Thirsk and Bath; lightly raced

runners.name: J Street
runners.spotlight: Can lack some concentration as when holding on last week at Doncaster (5f), for her second win in three starts; up 4lb and they claimed 5lb last week, so has more on her plate from stall 9.
runners.comment: Won two of her last three; has more on her plate than at Doncaster last week

runners.name: Riffa Spirit
runners.spotlight: A winner for the Crisfords; nearly won again at Musselburgh in April (5f) but has trailed home last in his two races since, latterly with a tongue-tie and blinkers tried (now removed); drawn wide.
runners.comment: Capable 3yo but finished last in final two races and he's drawn wide

runners.name: Tanjen
runners.spotlight: 2-4 on the AW as opposed to 0-11 on grass; hasn't got a lot going since back from a break.
runners.comment: Both wins on the AW and hasn't got a lot going since back from a break

runners.name: Sam's Xpress
runners.spotlight: Better known for his AW exploits (7-26) and he's now 0-16 on turf after finishing last at Lingfield following 99 days off; hard to warm to from stall 11.
runners.comment: Better known for his AW exploits (7-26) and he's hard to warm to from stall 11

runners.name: Maharajas Express
runners.spotlight: Not hit top gear this year but signs of a return to form when keeping on from off the pace here 14 days ago in a race he won the previous year; always dangerous if getting a strong pace to chase.
runners.comment: Course winner who is always dangerous if getting a strong pace to chase

runners.name: Naturalia
runners.spotlight: Runner-up three times in a row over 1m3f/1m4f on turf this summer and her 1m2f fourth at Ayr was similar form; big shout on that but the problem is that her AW form (six races, including three last autumn) is at a lower level.
runners.comment: Big shout on this summer's turf achievements but the problem is her lesser AW record

runners.name: Golspie
runners.spotlight: AW regular who scored here (1m2f) in December and has strung together a long line of minor honours this year; should be seriously involved.
runners.comment: C&D winner in December and has strung together a long line of minor honours this year

runners.name: Idyllic
runners.spotlight: Most of her best AW efforts were on Polytrack but there was a 2024 second on Wolverhampton Tapeta; won at Thirsk (1m4f) on this day last year off a 3lb higher mark; no joy since but her Ayr fourth (1m2f) on latest start was a healthy step back in the right direction.
runners.comment: Ayr fourth (1m2f) on latest start was a healthy step back in the right direction

runners.name: Maple
runners.spotlight: Had a hurdles win in spring 2025 and 2026; ten-race maiden on Flat but placed in four of his five attempts this year, including three times over C&D; had wind surgery after latest but firmly in the mix if all is okay.
runners.comment: Placed over C&D; had wind surgery after latest but firmly in the mix if all is okay
runners.owner: R Whitelock, L Clemitson & R Jefferson

runners.name: Gemini Man
runners.spotlight: Three wins from his first four Flat starts in 2026, including one over C&D; that record demands respect but he pulled up 25 days ago (bled from the nose) and needs to bounce back from that; 7lb claimer takes over.
runners.comment: Three wins from first four Flat starts in 2026; pulled up 25 days ago (bled from the nose)

runners.name: Rubellite
runners.spotlight: Eight AW wins, including under Conor Whiteley at Wolverhampton (1m6f) in May and Newcastle (1m4f) in June; failed to prove her effectiveness on turf on latest start and the trip this short is a concern, but she has to be respected back on AW.
runners.comment: Won under Conor Whiteley at Wolverhampton (1m6f) in May and Newcastle (1m4f) in June

runners.name: Token Love
runners.spotlight: 0-10; sold out of the Greenall/Guerriero yard for 4,000gns in June; five-runner race at Nottingham (1m2f) eight days ago on stable debut was the third time he's finished second and another was on Wolverhampton Tapeta last December; place possibility.
runners.comment: Three 2nds, including latest start (yard debut) and on Wolverhampton Tapeta last December

runners.name: Broadstone
runners.spotlight: 17-race maiden who came last in both starts this summer, one C&D; bits of form last year and cheekpieces (worn on last seven starts) are removed.
runners.comment: 17-race maiden who came last in both starts this summer, one over C&D

runners.name: Bearwith
runners.spotlight: Latest of his nine wins was over C&D in February off a 1lb higher mark; that helps show that he needs a second look, despite mixed fortunes since.
runners.comment: Latest win was C&D in February off 1lb higher; mixed fortunes since

runners.name: Sweet Kiss
runners.spotlight: Two C&D runs (fourth on first occasion) last autumn are the sum of her AW racing experience; 3-14 on turf thanks to winning three times over 1m2f under Jake Dickson in the space of four starts last August/September; big shout on peak form, which she's not quite reproduced this season.
runners.comment: Big shout on peak turf form, which she's not quite reproduced this season; unproven on AW

runners.name: Eagles Dream
runners.spotlight: Ex-Irish; 0-12 overall and, after nearly a year off, well beaten on both starts for new stable (22-1 and 28-1); the positives are that she's down the weights and steps back up from 1m1f/1m for this AW debut.
runners.comment: 0-12 overall and, after nearly a year off, well beaten both starts for new yard; AW debut

runners.name: Jewel Maker
runners.spotlight: Veteran who is 12-110 overall and 4-26 on Newcastle AW; his last two wins were on turf last autumn; 2026 form has not been great but the return to this track (first time this year) might offer hope.
runners.comment: Veteran who is 4-26 on Newcastle AW; return here (first time this year) might offer hope

runners.name: Cavalry Call
runners.spotlight: 1m turf and 1m2f AW winner for the Crisfords but he never took off for Mike Smith and finished last of seven on his stable debut ten weeks ago; impossible to recommend without a market move to offer revival hopes.
runners.comment: Never took off for last trainer and came last of seven on his stable debut ten weeks ago

runners.name: Tripoli Flyer
runners.spotlight: Very useful bumper performer and hurdler who won at Kempton (1m4f, Polytrack) 23 days ago on his Flat handicap debut, despite being first off the bridle; up 4lb but more to give in this sphere.
runners.comment: Very useful bumper performer and hurdler; won Flat handicap debut at Kempton (1m4f, AW)

runners.name: Lightning Tiger
runners.spotlight: Eight starts, with sole win on handicap debut at Catterick (1m4f, soft) last October; fourth on all four outings since but at least the best of those was on AW (Lingfield Polytrack on penultimate start); hooded last two; others look a bit more solid.
runners.comment: Eight starts, with sole win on handicap debut at Catterick (1m4f, soft) last October

runners.name: Ruby Wedding
runners.spotlight: Minor form improvement on all starts, getting off the mark (fifth attempt) when 4-6 in a four-runner handicap at Hamilton (1m3f) on latest; carried her head a bit high that day but had to battle to lead on the line; up 3lb for this AW debut but she's a lightly raced 3yo who may still do better.
runners.comment: 4-6, had to battle to lead on the line in four-runner handicap at Hamilton (1m3f); up 3lb

runners.name: Glory Road
runners.spotlight: Placed at Nottingham, Newbury (1m2f) and Carlisle (1m1f) in his three races before this handicap/AW debut; it was admittedly a shock defeat at 1-4 when beaten a neck last time but that was against a once-race Juddmonte colt and probably still a creditable effort; this trip makes appeal and he's a very different sort to the older, more exposed runners in this; one to note.
runners.comment: Shock defeat at 1-4 was probably still creditable; trip makes appeal for handicap debut

runners.name: Jindri
runners.spotlight: Won off 1lb lower at Southwell (1m4f, Tapeta) last November, from eight races; back near that form when second of five on turf at Chepstow (made most) three weeks ago, so enters calculations on this first run under a claiming rider.
runners.comment: Won off 1lb lower at Southwell (1m4f, Tapeta) last November; back near that form last time

runners.name: Aulis
runners.spotlight: Signed off for Ralph Beckett in good form on AW in autumn 2024 but, following a long absence, he was well held this summer in his two runs for new connections; some ability remains but he's best watched for now.
runners.comment: Following a long absence, he was well held this summer in his two runs for new connections

runners.name: Haveyoumissedme
runners.spotlight: 8yo who has run 20 times at Newcastle (vastly more than any other track) and had two wins here plus six seconds; latest second was in the 2m Northumberland Vase on latest start, having also been placed at this track three times over 1m2f this year, so he is likely to serve up the same highly competitive show over today's 1m4f.
runners.comment: Some big placed runs here at 1m2f/2m this year; should be competitive over today's 1m4f

runners.name: Lavender Gold
runners.spotlight: Had wind and gelding operations before reappearance; 6-4 co-favourite for a seven-runner handicap at Goodwood (1m2f, soft) six weeks ago on second run back and improved to win from the front, asserting in clearcut fashion; up 6lb and needs another step forward but that may well be possible.
runners.comment: Won from the front at Goodwood (1m2f, soft) six weeks ago in clearcut fashion; up 6lb
runners.owner: All For One Racing Ix & Chris Wright

runners.name: Eniac
runners.spotlight: 0-6 for Donnacha O'Brien in Ireland but staying-on third of ten in a maiden at Leopardstown (1m5f, good to firm) last time was his best form; flopped in 1m2f handicap the time before and also modest in his only AW race, but a positive start for his new connections is by no means ruled out.
runners.comment: Staying-on third in 1m5f maiden at Leopardstown was final/best form for Donnacha O'Brien

runners.name: Molinari
runners.spotlight: The last two of his seven wins were at this track, albeit in 2024; placed twice over 1m2f here in a mixed campaign last autumn/winter; well beaten at 25-1 five weeks ago, a run which he may have needed after six months off and he's now back to his last winning mark, but this race looks too hot.
runners.comment: Placed twice here in a mixed campaign last autumn/winter; back to last winning mark (2024)
runners.owner: Mr & Mrs G F Hall Racing

runners.name: Mick Collins
runners.spotlight: First run since leaving Noel Meade in Ireland for £70,000 in May; a pretty useful jumper for him (second on chase debut two weeks earlier) and won a 1m4f maiden in April 2025 in his latest Flat race; unexposed in this sphere (makes AW debut) and not written off.
runners.comment: Left Noel Meade for £70,000 in May; pretty useful jumper for him and 1m4f maiden winner

runners.name: Austrian Theory
runners.spotlight: Won once each in 2021, 2022, 2023 and 2024 but has not scored since and this season he's not at all been the force of old; wore cheekpieces on last two outings, with a respectable show on first occasion; the last of his three AW races was in 2024; unpersuasive.
runners.comment: Not at all the force of old; the last of his three AW races was in 2024

runners.name: Ouro Preto
runners.spotlight: Sole AW run (he came last) was in 2023; overall 3-15 in France and very well handicapped judged on plenty of 2025 form but he's not beaten many in his four runs for new stable; hard to latch on to unless there's been vastly more market interest in him this time.
runners.comment: Very well handicapped on plenty of 2025 French form but he's not beaten many for new yard

runners.name: Star Martini
runners.spotlight: 10,000euros yearling, resold 16,000gns yearling, 65,000euros breeze-up 2yo; fifth foal; half-sister to winners Enceladus (10.4f/1m4f; RPR 100) and Moab (1m6f AW; 75); dam prolific US 7f-8.5f winner (including Grade 2; 112); looks the part on paper; betting to guide.
runners.comment: 65,000euros breeze-up 2yo; dam a Grade 2 winner in the US; likely type on paper

runners.name: Fantasy Force
runners.spotlight: He made a promising start to his career when third of six at York (5f, good) in May; strong favourite for a Ripon novice last month on the strength of it but he was impeded over 1f out and couldn't show his true colours; remains with potential.
runners.comment: Hampered when short-priced favourite at Ripon latest; remains with potential

runners.name: Chan Noir
runners.spotlight: Had a subsequent nursery winner back in second when winning at Nottingham (6f, good to firm) last month; capable of better but that was only a Band D event and this will demand more.
runners.comment: Beat a subsequent nursery winner at Nottingham on debut but that was only a Band D event

runners.name: Gold Key
runners.spotlight: 62,000euros yearling; second foal; dam a 7f 2yo/1m2f Listed winner (RPR 98); may need further in time but he is still a newcomer to note for market confidence.
runners.comment: 62,000euros yearling; dam a 1m2f Listed winner; may need further but worth a market check

runners.name: Mirzimaan
runners.spotlight: Too green to do himself justice at Newmarket on debut in May but he took a significant step forward with his defeat of 17 rivals at Newbury (6f, good to firm) 16 days ago; from the family of Battaash and there should be more under the bonnet.
runners.comment: Green on debut but took big step forward when winning at Newbury 16 days ago; more to come

runners.name: Suenicora Star
runners.spotlight: Fifth foal; half-sister to Swedish 1m winner Crack Up Gaudelius; dam 6f/7f winner (including 2yo/AW; RPR 83), half-sister to Italian 7.5f winner Rekindled Amore; one of three for Brian Ellison.
runners.comment: Half-sister to a winner in Sweden out of a 6f/7f winner; stable run three

runners.name: Mollisha
runners.spotlight: 7,000euros yearling, £27,000 breeze-up 2yo; sixth foal; half-sister to winners Surrey Blaze (8.6f-1m4f; RPR 81), Arctic Blaze (10.6f AW/12.5f turf; 71) and Better Not Bitter (Australian (6f-1m1f); dam maiden half-sister to useful 7f-1m4f winner Adjaliya; one of three runners for Brian Ellison.
runners.comment: £27,000 breeze-up 2yo; half-sister to three winners; one of three runners for the stable

runners.name: Mind Those Steps
runners.spotlight: Stepped up on his Ripon debut third when winning a 6f novice at Hamilton in May; ten-week absence and the fitting of a tongue tie are slight concerns but he is bred to carry on improving.
runners.comment: Absent since a 6f win at Hamilton ten weeks ago; now tongue tied; bred to do better still

runners.name: Frontier Legend
runners.spotlight: Ninth foal; brother to Italian winners The King's Horses (5f-1m including 2yo Listed) and Time Of Rebirth (6f-1m1f including 2yo), closely related to 2m hurdle winner Chingachook; dam unraced half-sister to 5f Group 3 winner Astrophysical Jet; apprentice-ridden on debut.
runners.comment: Has three winning siblings; unraced dam from a good family; apprentice-ridden on debut

runners.name: On Golden Pond
runners.spotlight: 38,000gns yearling, £55,000 breeze-up 2yo; first foal; dam 1m-1m2f AW maiden (RPR 62), closely related to winners Scintiulla (1m1f Group 3), Cuis Ghaire (6f 2yo Group 3) and Gile Na Greine (smart 7f 2yo); neither of the stable's 2yo winners this year have won first time out.
runners.comment: £55,000 breeze-up 2yo; dam a maiden from a useful family; likely best watched on debut

runners.name: Odegaard
runners.spotlight: Two runs last month, showing better form on the second occasion; even that effort is still well short of the required standard here.
runners.comment: Second run better than his debut but he looks one for minor nurseries after this

runners.name: One Shot Kodi
runners.spotlight: 33-1 when finishing down the field at Redcar (6f, good to firm) in May; a big step forward is necessary.
runners.comment: Well-beaten 33-1 shot on her Redcar debut in May; big step forward essential

runners.name: Rotelle
runners.spotlight: Travelled strongly and picked up well to record a snug success in a 5f novice at Nottingham (5f, good) in April; gelded last month;   open to improvement and 6f should suit well.
runners.comment: Snug 5f win at Nottingham in April; gelded since; capable of better

runners.name: Asander
runners.spotlight: Some promise when fourth of six at Beverley (7.4f, good to firm) three weeks ago; others look stronger all the same.
runners.comment: Some promise on Beverley debut but others bring far more obvious claims.

races.race_name: Brack Burger On Uber Eats Beeswing Handicap (Div I)

runners.name: Sovereign View
runners.spotlight: Ended 2025 with C&D victory and he's advanced his form this season, posting good third of 14 in 1m Kempton handicap 26 days ago; cheekpieces added; merits consideration from an unchanged mark.
runners.comment: Ended 2025 with C&D victory and he's advanced his form this season; merits consideration

runners.name: Zatsgood
runners.spotlight: Ex-French gelding who made a winning handicap debut on AW at Lingfield (1m) in May; tongue tied when good third in 1m Kempton handicap last time; has few miles still on the clock and may do better still; likely player.
runners.comment: Good third in 1m Kempton handicap latest; may do better still so a likely player

runners.name: Viper
runners.spotlight: Improving son of Zoustar who gained a first win (at the fourth attempt) in 7f novice here 29 days ago; yard took this 12 months ago, and he's open to further progress stepping up to 1m for his handicap debut; interesting.
runners.comment: Bagged novice here latest; open to further progress up to 1m for h'cap debut; interesting

runners.name: Rogue Encore
runners.spotlight: Signed off for 2025 with a third C&D success in September but he's yet to fire this season, last of 14 over C&D in April; has it to prove after a break.
runners.comment: Signed off for 2025 with a third C&D success in September but he's yet to fire this season

runners.name: Victory Ace
runners.spotlight: Made a winning return in 7f AW handicap at Lingfield in April and posted a solid fifth of 14 over C&D last month; remains low mileage and not ruled out for yard among the winners.
runners.comment: Solid fifth of 14 over C&D last month; not ruled out for yard among the winners

runners.name: Hot Cash
runners.spotlight: Fairly useful 1m winner in 2025; back on track when runner-up in handicaps (around 1m) at Thirsk and Epsom this summer but only eighth at Sandown (1m) last time; needs to bounce back.
runners.comment: In good form until only eighth at Sandown (1m) last time; needs to bounce back

runners.name: Pandemonium
runners.spotlight: Bagged Yarmouth maiden and Redcar novice (both 7f) last autumn; cheekpieces fitted and right back on track of late, a close sixth of nine in 1m1f Musselburgh handicap 25 days ago; in the mix on his Tapeta debut with blinkers added.
runners.comment: Right back on track of late; in the mix on his Tapeta debut with blinkers added

runners.name: Simon Pierre
runners.spotlight: Zelzal colt who landed 1m Thirsk novice in April; well-held seventh of nine on handicap debut at Chester (1m2f) last month; tongue tied here and worth another chance after just three starts.
runners.comment: Well-held seventh on Chester h'cap debut last month; worth another chance after three runs

runners.name: Tasever
runners.spotlight: Bagged a fourth C&D success in February; off since a below-par seventh over C&D in March though so needs to hit the ground running.
runners.comment: Bagged fourth C&D win in February; off since a below-par seventh over C&D in March though

runners.name: Shamalza
runners.spotlight: Debut 1m Navan maiden winner for Dermot Weld last autumn; off seven months before a fading fourth of five in 7f Newmarket novice for new yard 30 days ago; sent off evens there, and remains with potential now going handicapping.
runners.comment: Off seven months before fourth at Newmarket; remains with potential on h'cap debut

runners.name: On The River
runners.spotlight: On a losing sequence and he was a below-par fifth of nine in 1m Nottingham handicap last month; others are preferred.
runners.comment: On a losing sequence and a below-par fifth of nine in 1m Nottingham handicap last month

runners.name: Zowal
runners.spotlight: Looked on the up when landing 1m Pontefract handicap in April but failed to build on it when third of five at Nottingham (1m) last month; still low mileage and not written off.
runners.comment: Scored at Pontefract but failed to build on it with Nottingham third; not written off

runners.name: Vincent Rocks
runners.spotlight: Landed 1m novices on his first two starts in 2025; signed off for Hugo Palmer with a good second of ten in 1m Kempton handicap 23 days ago; changed hands for 30,000 guineas and not out of things for new handler.
runners.comment: Signed off for Hugo Palmer with good second at Kempton; not out of things for new yard

runners.name: Regalian
runners.spotlight: Debut course winner for William Haggas; failed to build on encouraging reappearance Redcar sixth for new stable when only eighth of 11 over C&D 30 days ago; needs to get back on track.
runners.comment: Failed to build on encouraging reappearance with C&D eighth; needs to get back on track

races.race_name: Brack Burger On Uber Eats Beeswing Handicap (Div II)

runners.name: Penny Time
runners.spotlight: Looked on the up in a trio of 1m AW novices (scored at Southwell) in the spring; run best ignored (badly hampered under 2f out) when last on turf debut in 7.5f Chester handicap last month; remains with potential returned to Tapeta with cheekpieces fitted.
runners.comment: Progressive on AW; badly hampered on turf debut at Chester latest; remains with potential

runners.name: Fantastic Fox
runners.spotlight: On a long losing run but a useful AW performer at his best; off 7 months before coming in only 11th in 1m1f York handicap on his return last month but this C&D winner bounce back.
runners.comment: On long losing run but useful AW performer; no surprise to see this C&D winner bounce back

runners.name: Callianassa
runners.spotlight: Took this in 2025 and also scored over C&D in February; not at her best when 11th over C&D last time but she's the sort to bounce back.
runners.comment: Took this in 2025; not at her best when 11th over C&D last time but sort to bounce back

runners.name: Pal Joey
runners.spotlight: Kickstarted 2026 with 5f win here but his form has nosedived since; it's easy to look elsewhere.
runners.comment: Kickstarted 2026 with 5f win here but his form has nosedived since; easy to look elsewhere

runners.name: Fight Your Corner
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced 5yo who went 2-4 when scoring on his handicap debut at Kempton (1m) in January, despite conceding first run; off since but he remains very much one to be interested in with Billy Loughnane up.
runners.comment: Cosy winner at Kempton in January; off since but remains very much one to be interested in

runners.name: Chuzzlewit
runners.spotlight: Winless since 2024 (over C&D) but runner-up in 1m handicaps here on his last two starts; can't be dismissed despite being 3lb out of the handicap.
runners.comment: Winless since 2024 (over C&D) but twice runner-up here recently; not dismissed

runners.name: Izzari
runners.spotlight: Dual winner (including here) in 2025 but his more recent turf form is much less encouraging; needs to bounce back returned to Tapeta.
runners.comment: Dual winner (including here) in 2025 but his more recent turf form is far less encouraging

runners.name: Freddie Steady Go
runners.spotlight: Fair bumper winner; got off the mark on his third Flat start in 7f Carlisle novice in May and not discredited with eighth of 16 in 1m1f York handicap last month; respected on his Tapeta debut.
runners.comment: Not discredited with eighth of 16 in York h'cap last month; respected on his Tapeta debut
runners.owner: Castle View, A Bell, S Oliver & M Severs

runners.name: One Night Thunder
runners.spotlight: A two-time 7f scorer last September; posted a good third at Haydock (7f) in May but beat just one in 1m Nottingham handicap last month; needs to get back on track.
runners.comment: Beat just one in 1m Nottingham handicap last month; needs to get back on track

runners.name: Calyxoh
runners.spotlight: On a losing run but posted his best effort for new stable with third of nine in 7.5f Chester handicap two weeks ago; in the mix if taking another step forward.
runners.comment: Best effort for new stable with third at Chester two weeks ago; in the mix

runners.name: Mr Mistoffelees
runners.spotlight: C&D winner who comes here on the back of a good second of five in 1m Doncaster handicap last month, just failing; not out of things despite a 2lb weights rise.
runners.comment: C&D winner; good second at Doncaster latest; not out of things despite 2lb weights rise

runners.name: Empirestateofmind
runners.spotlight: A fair 1m1f winner in 2025 but arrives out of sorts, beating one in 1m handicap at Pontefract eight days ago; others are preferred.
runners.comment: A fair 1m1f winner in 2025 but arrives out of sorts; others are preferred

runners.name: Metal Merchant
runners.spotlight: A useful 1m winner at his best for Jack Channon; offered little in two runs for Brian Toomey this spring though and came in last of 14 for John Butler in 7f handicap here four weeks ago; no surprise if he took a step forward though with new yard among the winners.
runners.comment: A useful 1m winner at his best; last of 14 for new yard here four weeks ago; more needed

runners.name: Book Of Life
runners.spotlight: Doesn't always appear the most resolute in a finish but he is regularly placed and conditions hold no terrors; each-way claims once more.
runners.comment: Conditions no problem and capable at this level but his poor strike-rate dents confidence

runners.name: Mercurius Power
runners.spotlight: Getting on for two years since his last win but this C&D winner has dropped to a tempting mark and he didn't run badly in a stronger race at Doncaster (1m, good to soft) six weeks ago; apprentice takes off a handy 5lb too; high on the list.
runners.comment: Conditions to suit and he lurks on a dangerous mark; on a losing run but still respected

runners.name: Miners Gamble
runners.spotlight: Just one win to his name from 26 starts; lacklustre effort here (6f) last month and underwent wind surgery four days later; handy mark if the operation has the desired effect.
runners.comment: Poor strike-rate but conditions no problem and he has had a wind op since last seen

runners.name: Adelaide Bay
runners.spotlight: He has finished second in two of his four starts since returned to Jane Chapple-Hyam; disappointing favourite at Wolverhampton 11 days ago, however, and stamina for this trip has to be taken on trust.
runners.comment: Capable at this level but latest run was disappointing and he's not a guaranteed stayer

runners.name: Arranmore
runners.spotlight: His last two wins have come on Tapeta but over longer trips, the latest (1m3f, Southwell) in March off 3lb lower; could prove vulnerable back at 1m.
runners.comment: Course winner but today's drop back to 1m isn't sure to be in his favour

runners.name: Pebble Dash
runners.spotlight: 0-18; eyecatching effort over 6f at Hamilton last month but he has been well beaten twice since; a new visor isn't enough to tempt.
runners.comment: Two disappointing runs have followed an eyecatching Hamilton run; new headgear today; 0-18

runners.name: Little Ted
runners.spotlight: The winner of nine races, including C&D, and arrives in good form having finished second in three of his last four races; did rather throw away his latest start at Leicester though, surging to the lead 1f out but dossing in front and picked off close home; has the ability to win but he will need producing late.
runners.comment: C&D winner and arrives in form but he did rather throw the race away at Leicester latest

runners.name: Defence Missile
runners.spotlight: 14-race maiden; tumbling down the weights and his latest Hamilton run was a little better; still not easily recommend though.
runners.comment: Exposed maiden; down in weights and latest run was a bit better; still looks vulnerable

runners.name: Wheres The Crumpet
runners.spotlight: C&D winner; successful at Carlisle last May; solid effort at Southwell in January but little to celebrate since; others bring more pressing claims.
runners.comment: C&D winner; out of sorts since March and she is easy enough to swerve

runners.name: Raja Charger
runners.spotlight: Yet to show any promise in six runs from 6f to 1m3f.
runners.comment: Yet to show any promise in six runs from 6f to 1m3f

runners.name: Sievier
runners.spotlight: Poor form in five starts for Jack Channon; starts out for new yard (same owners) after 404 days off; hard to recommend.
runners.comment: Poor form in five runs for J Channon; best watched on stable debut after 404-day absence

runners.name: Suzette
runners.spotlight: Won a nursery at Carlisle (7f, soft) off a 15lb higher mark in August 2024; not at the same level last year but starts out for her new yard off a reduced mark; tongue tied; worth a market check.
runners.comment: Quiet year in 2025 but makes stable debut off reduced mark as a result; now tongue tied

runners.name: Ellie's de Vega
runners.spotlight: 11-race maiden; threatened on turf in the spring but his progress has stalled more recently; looks to have a bit to prove.
runners.comment: 0-11 and his progress appears to have stalled; others are more persuasive

runners.name: Sparkling Wine
runners.spotlight: Runner-up at Catterick (5f, good to soft) and Beverley (5f, good to firm) this summer; not so good at Southwell on Thursday but this test could suit better.
runners.comment: Runner-up twice on turf this summer; not so good at Southwell on Thursday

runners.name: Black Cab
runners.spotlight: The form of his 5f win at Wolverhampton in May has been franked since; a 5lb higher mark should be in range and the booking of Billy Loughnane suggests he will be ready to go after 81 days off.
runners.comment: 5f win in May has been franked since; 5lb rise manageable and Billy Loughnane booked

runners.name: Too Much
runners.spotlight: Course winner (6f/7f); not at her best in three runs this year but dropping down the weights and this is an ease in grade; has run well over C&D before but she may need more of a test.
runners.comment: Not found her best form this year; down in the weights but 5f looks on the sharp side

runners.name: Sugar Bon Bon
runners.spotlight: Big prices and he has run to a modest level in three sprint novices this year; did hint at better last time and his trainer has enjoyed plenty of success with his half-brother Sugar Baby; worth a market check now handicapping.
runners.comment: Well beaten in 3 novices but hinted at better last time; likely improver now handicapping

runners.name: Breeze Star
runners.spotlight: Seven-race maiden who was held at Carlisle (6f, soft) last month following a wind operation; others have stronger claims.
runners.comment: Seven-race maiden; no improvement for wind surgery when well held at Carlisle latest

runners.name: Sally Anne's Dream
runners.spotlight: Exposed low-grade maiden; 80-1 when well held over 6f here four weeks ago.
runners.comment: Exposed low-grade maiden; 80-1 when well held over 6f here four weeks ago

runners.name: Auradue
runners.spotlight: Appeared to show improvement when fourth of eight at Doncaster (6f, good to firm) four weeks ago but they went steadily to halfway and it may not be a reliable piece of form; yard do well with this type though and she is at least unexposed.
runners.comment: Better effort when 4th at Doncaster last month; still has low mileage; worth market check

runners.name: A Lady Forever
runners.spotlight: Course winner (6f) for another yard in February 2025; runner-up over C&D in June and a subsequent lesser effort on turf isn't the run to judge her on; each-way shout.
runners.comment: Conditions hold no terrors and she holds each-way claims at this level

runners.name: Let's Go Hugo
runners.spotlight: Three-time AW winner, two of them over C&D, and he is 4lb lower than for his win here last September; wouldn't judge him too harshly on a couple of low-key 6f runs when last seen; strong claims back at 5f on AW.
runners.comment: Well handicapped on plenty of C&D form; strong claims returned to 5f and AW

races.race_name: After Party At Tup Tup Palace Classified Stakes

runners.name: Filey Beach
runners.spotlight: Won two 7f Catterick handicaps in May and was placed in this grade at Wolverhampton (7f) when back on AW last month; didn't fire when back at Catterick 17 days ago but still a major player here.
runners.comment: Dual turf handicap winner this spring and placed on Tapeta since; good chance

runners.name: Sassy Glory
runners.spotlight: Held on gamely to make all in 1m handicap here last month and is now 2-31; evidently in good nick but this drop back in trip is not sure to suit.
runners.comment: Held on gamely to make all over 1m here last month; this drop back to 7f may not be ideal
runners.owner: Ursa Major & Mark Walford Racing Club

runners.name: Angel Of England
runners.spotlight: Has modest 1-31 strike-rate but gave good account when third of 13 in 6f handicap here last month and now dips into this basement grade for the first time; fine over 7f; high on the list.
runners.comment: Placed in 6f handicap here last month and now dips into this grade for the first time
runners.owner: The Jocks And The Geordies II

runners.name: I Can Boogy
runners.spotlight: Needs to bounce back quickly from duff effort on turf nine days ago but has been placed here three times (7f-1m) since his 1m course win in February and has a big role to play if back on song.
runners.comment: Ran poorly on turf last week but has good claims if judged on this year's course form

runners.name: Langton Wold
runners.spotlight: Versatile 7yo who gave fairly good account when fifth in 1m2f handicap here last month, after a 556-day absence; that run might have brought him on but this is his first 7f start since 2022.
runners.comment: Ran okay over 1m2f last month, after long absence, but has trip query at 7f
runners.owner: Brian Ellison Racing Club & M Dale

runners.name: Belling The Cat
runners.spotlight: Eight-race maiden; respectable fourth in Catterick handicap (good) when upped to 7f and fitted with cheekpieces in May but last month's 6f run was a backward step; cheekpieces now removed; tongue-tie added.
runners.comment: Eight-race maiden; ran quite well in 7f handicap in May but safely held since

runners.name: Le Puy
runners.spotlight: Displayed promise when fourth of six in Catterick novice (7f, good) in April and may not have handled soft ground when soundly beaten in her other two qualifying races; remains unexposed and is sure to appreciate this ease in grade on AW debut; interesting.
runners.comment: Unexposed after only three runs and sure to appreciate this ease in grade

runners.name: Twilight Dawn
runners.spotlight: Beaten about 8l when third in Redcar handicap (7f, good) last month but has now been placed on consecutive starts over that C&D; should be fine back on Tapeta; more appealing than most.
runners.comment: Placed in 7f Redcar handicaps on last two outings; more appealing than most

runners.name: Charcon
