runners.spotlight: Always behind in 6f Redcar handicap last month and now 0-7; wore a visor last time; cheekpieces given a whirl here; considered only if lively in the betting.
runners.comment: Always behind in 6f Redcar handicap last month and now 0-6; headgear switched

runners.name: Trais Fluors
runners.spotlight: Veteran who gained the last five of his 13 wins here (7f-1m); not firing on all cylinders in recent weeks, though, and needs to up his game.
runners.comment: Veteran; well suited by this track but not firing on all cylinders lately

runners.name: Timebar
runners.spotlight: 0-17 but bettered his low-key seasonal debut when second in this grade at Nottingham (6f, soft) last month and will also be suited by today's trip and ground combination; a possible.
runners.comment: Second in this grade last month (6f, soft) and also suited by today's trip/surface

runners.name: Go Teejay
runners.spotlight: Not beaten far when sixth of nine on handicap debut at Doncaster (7f, good to firm; first-time cheekpieces) in May but came last of ten on latest turf start; others have much stronger claims.
runners.comment: Not beaten far on handicap debut but came last of ten last time; others more obvious

runners.name: The Floors Munky
runners.spotlight: Seven-race maiden who has struggled to get competitive off basement marks in handicaps in recent months; swaps cheekpieces for first-time blinkers.
runners.comment: Seven-race maiden who has struggled to get competitive off basement marks

runners.name: Mick The Hat
runners.spotlight: Six-race maiden who has flopped at Wolverhampton (1m4f/1m6f) in his last two runs but he showed promise with his keeping-on third in a Ffos Las handicap (1m4f, good to soft) last month; that form puts him in the picture and he's a player if he can get back on track with blinkers added.
runners.comment: Has struggled on AW last twice but he's still lightly raced and could revive in headgear

runners.name: Sixty Plus
runners.spotlight: Won four times over hurdles between July and September last year; lost his way in that sphere and struggled this summer in his first three Flat runs (1m2f-1m6f) but he should have a future in Flat handicaps, as he showed when winning well in a small field at Thirsk (1m4f, good to firm) on Friday; hard to beat under a penalty if in the same form.
runners.comment: Should have a future in Flat handicaps, as he showed when winning well at Thirsk on Friday

runners.name: Panthere Noir
runners.spotlight: Inconsistent 15-race maiden but he was front-running third at Windsor (11.4f, good to firm) in May and it was the same story behind a handicap blot at Epsom (1m4f, good) last time; this is a new test at this trip but he has possibilities if his stamina holds out.
runners.comment: 0-15 and this is a new test at this trip but has claims if his stamina holds out

runners.name: Alex The Great
runners.spotlight: Regressive 6yo who has struggled in five hurdle runs this year and was well held back on the Flat in a classified event here (1m4f, AW) 12 days ago; this step back up in trip should suit but losing run is up to 20 and all of his three wins have been on AW; others preferred.
runners.comment: Regressive 6yo who is on a long losing run and all of his wins have been on AW

runners.name: Homeland
runners.spotlight: Added to his Ripon win last summer when justifying favouritism with a comfortable success at Ffos Las (1m2f, good; 2-1) last Monday; remains feasibly treated off only 3lb higher and he has form figures of 33511 at this trip; key player.
runners.comment: Justified favouritism at Ffos Las last week and a 3lb rise looks fair; big player

runners.name: Celtic Spirit
runners.spotlight: 0-6 but he was runner-up in a handicap here (7.6f, good) in May and he made late gains when a close fifth at Windsor (1m, good to firm; cheekpieces added) last month; still has potential and he looks interesting on this step up to 1m2f.
runners.comment: 0-6 but he's been beaten less than 2l in his last two runs; in the mix upped to 1m2f

runners.name: Haveagobeau
runners.spotlight: Record of 2-38 but his last win was on AW here (1m2f) in March and he went close in an Epsom handicap (1m2f, good) three weeks ago; only 1lb higher than for that last run and he's respected on this drop back in grade.
runners.comment: Went close at Epsom latest and he's only 1lb higher on this drop back in grade; respected

runners.name: Dogged
runners.spotlight: Hasn't won since 2023 but he went close in a Brighton handicap (1m2f, good to firm) last month; has claims on that form but he's not easy to predict and was beaten 15l back at Brighton two weeks ago; risks attached.
runners.comment: Went close at Brighton (1m2f) last month but he flopped on his return visit two weeks ago

runners.name: Leia Antilles
runners.spotlight: Well held in all six runs including three handicaps (1m2f/1m) this summer; dropped another 2lb but she needs a transformation back up in trip.
runners.comment: Well held in all six runs and she needs a transformation back up in trip

runners.name: Mister Pretentious
runners.spotlight: Big prices and he's not finished closer than 13l to a winner in his five starts and has a best RPR of 35; opposable back in trip.
runners.comment: Has struggled at big prices in all five runs and has a best RPR of 35; opposable

races.race_name: Pristine Homes Restricted Maiden Fillies' Stakes (Band D) (GBB Race)

runners.name: Summer Triangle
runners.spotlight: Didn't show much at Ascot (5f, good) in May but she returned after a break with a bold bid behind an odds-on rival at Epsom (7f, good to firm) two weeks ago; sets the standard on that form and she's open to more progress on this drop back in trip; big player.
runners.comment: Big improvement when runner-up at Epsom and she sets the standard on that form

runners.name: Last Dandelion
runners.spotlight: 0-5 but she was placed on AW here (6f) last month and bounced back with a respectable fourth in a Bath maiden (5f, firm) last week; needs to find something extra but cheekpieces are now added and this step back in trip looks a good move.
runners.comment: Fair fourth in a Bath maiden last time and she's in the mix with cheekpieces added

runners.name: Wild Orchid
runners.spotlight: 18,000euros yearling; fourth foal; half-sister to winners Calla Lagoon (Listed-placed 7f 2yo; RPR 101) and Calanthe (1m AW; 79); dam maiden (70) half-sister to 6f 2yo Group 2 winner Calyx, out of 1m 2yo Group 3 winning sister to 6f Group 1 winner African Rose; yard 14% with 2yos this year and market should guide on debut.
runners.comment: 18,000euros yearling; yard 14% with 2yos this year and market should guide on debut

runners.name: Fortunate
runners.spotlight: Ran well to finish fourth in useful seller at Chester (6f, good) in May, but that is her standout effort from six starts and she failed to beat a rival in a nursery at Catterick (cheekpieces added) last time; opposable.
runners.comment: Six-race maiden who failed to beat a rival in a Catterick nursery last time; opposable

runners.name: Spirit Of Lyra
runners.spotlight: Never dangerous when 9-2 on recent Ripon debut (6f, good) but she made some late headway into fourth and that was a promising effort; should be more streetwise this time and she's a likely improver on her second start.
runners.comment: Shaped with promise when fourth on Ripon debut and she should improve for that experience

runners.name: Yankeedoodledandy
runners.spotlight: Tailed off in her first two starts but she showed promise when a strong-finishing third at Bath (5f, firm; 80-1) last week; ties in with Last Dandelion on that form and she's open to more progress on this step back up in trip; not ruled out.
runners.comment: Tailed off in first two starts but she showed promise at Bath last week; not ruled out

runners.name: Roberts Legacy
runners.spotlight: 28-1 and she beat only one rival in a 13-runner maiden at Yarmouth (6f, good to firm) last month.
runners.comment: 28-1 and she beat only one rival in a 13-runner maiden at Yarmouth (6f) last month

runners.name: Mystic Ballistic
runners.spotlight: 3,000gns yearling; 14-1 on C&D debut (good to firm) ten days ago and she never got involved before finishing a well-held fifth of seven; should know more this time but she needs plenty of improvement; hood removed.
runners.comment: Made a low-key start over C&D last week and others are preferred

races.race_name: RJB Agri EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)

runners.name: It Dunt Marra
runners.spotlight: Made a solid start when second of five at Goodwood (5f, good) last month; never dangerous when highly tried in a Listed race at Sandown three weeks ago but he didn't get the best of runs and was only beaten 4l; sets a good standard back in calmer waters and he's a key player for in-form yard.
runners.comment: Runner-up at Goodwood before a creditable effort in a Listed race at Sandown; key player

runners.name: Catching Dreams
runners.spotlight: Showcasing colt; third foal; dam 5f/6f winner (including 2yo; RPR 95), half-sister to winners Tone The Barone (prolific 5f/6f) and Mrs Gallagher (5f/5.5f Listed), out of Listed-placed 6f winner; plenty to like on paper and yard has 42% record with 2yos this season.
runners.comment: Plenty to like on paper and yard has 42% record with 2yos this season

runners.name: Desert Legend
runners.spotlight: Disappointing at Newbury two weeks ago but that was an 18-runner novice and he showed good pace when third on his Windsor debut (6f, good to firm) last month; has possibilities if he can build on that and he has shaped as though this drop in trip could suit.
runners.comment: His Windsor debut was a promising effort and he's not ruled out on this drop in trip

runners.name: Marralyn
runners.spotlight: Well held in all three runs, most recently when a 7l third of five at Bath (5f, good) last month; stablemate of It Dunt Marra and she can only be watched.
runners.comment: Well held in all three runs, most recently when a 7l third of five at Bath (5f) last month

runners.name: American Psycho
runners.spotlight: £130,000 half-brother to four juvenile winners; made a promising start when runner-up at Salisbury (5f, good) in May and his disappointing run at Wolverhampton (last of seven) was just four days later; been gelded since but he needs watching in the market back from a break.
runners.comment: Been gelded since his disappointing run at Wolverhampton; market informative after a break

runners.name: Cash Flow Boy
runners.spotlight: 28-1 and he's finished down the field in 5f novice events at Windsor and Chepstow (both on good to firm); has plenty to find here and nurseries will be more suitable.
runners.comment: Down the field at 28-1 in both his runs and nurseries will be more suitable

runners.name: Its A Ginger Thing
runners.spotlight: Finished in rear in 6f novice events at Windsor and Newbury (both on good to firm), with a best RPR of 54; remains best watched for now.
runners.comment: Finished in rear in both his runs, with a best RPR of 54; remains best watched for now
runners.owner: E Kelly, J Woods, N Gallagher & Partner

runners.name: Be An Angel
runners.spotlight: Resurgent 4yo who won an apprentice handicap at Salisbury (6f, good to firm; cheekpieces added) two weeks ago and she didn't get much luck when a close second at Chepstow last Wednesday; 2lb higher here but she remains well treated on old form and is strongly respected.
runners.comment: Won at Salisbury and she didn't get much luck when a close second at Chepstow last week

runners.name: The Feminine Urge
runners.spotlight: Three sprint wins on turf and her last success was off 10lb higher at York last June; has been up and down for new yard this season but she was placed at Newbury (6f, good to firm) last time and has claims if she can back that up.
runners.comment: On reduced mark and she returned to form with a third at Newbury last time; possibilities

runners.name: Dark Sun
runners.spotlight: Plenty of near-misses before finally off the mark over 5f at Bath (good) last month; still looks on a workable mark but she's not easy to predict and was disappointing after a slow start at Salisbury (6f, good to firm) last time; risks attached.
runners.comment: Made the breakthrough at Bath last month but she was disappointing at Salisbury last time

runners.name: Pilgrim's Progress
runners.spotlight: Runner-up on AW here in her last two starts including a close call in a novice (5f) in December and a 3l second on handicap debut (6f) 12 days ago; should benefit from that last run and she's still unexposed after only four starts; in the mix back on turf.
runners.comment: Reappeared with second on handicap debut here (6f, AW) 12 days ago; respected back on turf

runners.name: Spacewoman
runners.spotlight: Off the mark at the eighth attempt with a narrow win at Newmarket (6f, good to firm) last month; couldn't pose a serious threat when third at Leicester last time but she finished well and that was an eye-catching effort; still unexposed as a sprint handicapper and has claims if she gets a good pace to aim at.
runners.comment: Won at Newmarket before an eye-catching third at Leicester; dangerous

runners.name: Rumble Ruby
runners.spotlight: Half-sister to five winners including Queues Likely (5f-1m including German Group 3; RPR 99); well held in her first two starts but her form really took off with a clearcut win in a C&D novice (good; 5-1) last month; looks on a fair mark now switched to handicap and she has plenty of scope for further progress; interesting contender.
runners.comment: Won a C&D novice last time and she's open to more progress on handicap debut; key player

runners.name: Duskaura
runners.spotlight: Won a Ripon maiden (5f, good) last June; highly tried in Listed events in final two juvenile runs but she's not threatened in five handicaps for new yard this season; mark continues to fall but she struggled at Nottingham last time and others are preferred.
runners.comment: Sole win was 13 months ago and she struggled at Nottingham last time; opposable

runners.name: Espona Bay
runners.spotlight: Made the breakthrough at Wolverhampton (7f, AW) in May and he's finished a creditable third on turf (1m, good to firm) and Tapeta (7f) since; now returns to sprinting but he has plenty of form at this trip and still looks on a workable mark; in the mix.
runners.comment: Won on Tapeta in May and he's been placed in both subsequent runs; in the mix back at 6f

runners.name: Goldwork
runners.spotlight: Justified favouritism in a Goodwood novice (6f, good) last May but he's 0-8 since and has been inconsistent; now 7lb lower than for his opening mark but he struggled at Epsom last time and others are more convincing; tongue-tie added.
runners.comment: Sole win was in a novice last May and he struggled at Epsom last time; tongue-tie added

runners.name: Adalida
runners.spotlight: Has a patchy profile but she won over C&D (good) in May and got back on the scoresheet with a narrow success at Yarmouth (5f, good to firm) ten days ago; up 3lb but she was as good as ever last time and she's respected back at this track.
runners.comment: Won over C&D in May and she got back on the scoresheet at Yarmouth last time; respected

runners.name: Debrief
runners.spotlight: 100,000gns foal; well held in his first two starts but he really got his act together with a comfortable win in a Brighton (6f, good to firm) last month; opening mark is no gift but he has a useful pedigree and could have a lot more to offer in handicaps; key player.
runners.comment: Comfortable winner at Brighton and he's open to more progress on handicap debut

runners.name: Sir Alfie
runners.spotlight: Two sprint wins in Ireland as 2yo, including when making all at the Curragh (6f, good) last August; well handicapped on that form but he's struggled since and has form figures of 89089 for his current yard; lost to prove.
runners.comment: Ex-Irish gelding who has form figures of 89089 for his current yard; lots to prove

runners.name: Diomed Duke
runners.spotlight: Front-runner who won over C&D last summer and was a creditable second in a Class 4 at Newmarket (5f, good to firm) last week; hasn't had much luck with the draw but he's 1lb lower than last time and is a big player if he can repeat that form.
runners.comment: C&D winner who was runner-up at Newmarket last week; big player off 1lb lower

runners.name: Lazzar
runners.spotlight: Four-time AW winner who is 0-11 on turf but finished well to snatch second in a C&D handicap (good to firm) last month; left Richard Hughes for 15,000gns since; on same mark as last time and he's a player if he gets a good pace and some luck; cheekpieces are removed.
runners.comment: 0-11 on turf but he was a close second over C&D latest; respected on stable debut

runners.name: Sandscreendeliverd
runners.spotlight: Just 1-16 but his win was over C&D (good) last summer; has been up and down this season but he had a near-miss at Goodwood in May and was a fair third on AW here last time; usually races prominently and it wouldn't be a surprise if he made a bold bid.
runners.comment: C&D winner who was a fair third on AW here last time; could make a bold bid back on turf

runners.name: Miracleoftheandes
runners.spotlight: Unexposed 3yo who returned after a year off with a promising second in a Nottingham novice (5f, good to firm; first run after wind surgery) three weeks ago; flashed her tail in that race but it's still early days and she needs a close look on handicap debut.
runners.comment: Handicap newcomer who was runner-up on her comeback at Nottingham; needs a close look

runners.name: The Thames Boatman
runners.spotlight: Record of 1-20 on turf but that win was off 1lb lower at Goodwood in May; hasn't matched that form in three subsequent runs but he ran into a well-handicapped rival when a 4l second at Salisbury (5f, good to firm) last time; now drops back into a Class 5 event and he's not ruled out.
runners.comment: Just 1-20 on turf but that win was off 1lb lower at Goodwood (5f) in May; not ruled out

runners.name: Ziggy's Missile
runners.spotlight: Six-time winner, with five on AW and one on turf; well handicapped on his Nottingham win (5f, good) last summer but he's been out sorts in three runs this season and needs a big turnaround.
runners.comment: On dangerous mark but he's been out of sorts this season and needs a big turnaround

runners.name: Our Planet
runners.spotlight: Won a Leicester maiden (5f, good) on stable debut last July but he struggled in handicaps in his final two runs last season; overall record is now 1-10 and he has something to prove after 277 days off.
runners.comment: Overall record is 1-10 and he has something to prove after 277 days off

races.race_name: Starman At Tally Ho Stud British EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)

runners.name: Sierra Belle
runners.spotlight: Out of a useful and well-connected 6f 2yo winner; made promising debut at Newmarket (6f, good to firm) a fortnight ago, keeping on well from the rear and losing out only by a neck, and makes obvious appeal.
runners.comment: Kept on well from the rear to go close on recent Newmarket debut; makes obvious appeal

runners.name: Debutante
runners.spotlight: Second foal; dam unraced half-sister to winners Starman (6f including Group 1 July Cup) and Sunday Star (Group-placed 6f/7f); good market support will bring her into the equation.
runners.comment: Out of a half-sister to July Cup winner Starman; market may guide on debut

runners.name: Pride Of Toledo
runners.spotlight: Half-brother to Irish 6f 2yo Group 2 winner Aloha Star; looked threatening before fading into fifth behind impressive winner at Newbury (6f, good to firm) three weeks ago; should build on that performance here.
runners.comment: Looked threatening before fading into fifth behind impressive winner at Newbury (6f)

runners.name: Hemustbeanangel
runners.spotlight: Out of a 6f Listed 2yo winner who has produced a US Grade 3 winner; displayed only a modicum of promise when a down-the-field 33-1 shot on debut at Windsor (6f, good to firm) last month.
runners.comment: Displayed only a modicum of promise when a down-the-field 33-1 shot on debut at Windsor
runners.owner: James Dellaway And Jon & Kay Collins

runners.name: Kinetic Impact
runners.spotlight: Raced too freely and was slightly disappointing when fifth in 1m2f Pontefract maiden this month but made the frame over that trip on first two starts and will be a threat if able to match that level of form over 1m.
runners.comment: Latest 1m2f run was a shade disappointing; twice made the frame over that trip beforehand

runners.name: Matins
runners.spotlight: Sixth foal; brother to 7f winner Consecrated (RPR 98), closely related to two winners including Enshrine (1m; 81), half-brother to 5f-7f winner Sacred (including Group 2; 116); dam French 12.5f winner, half-sister to US 1m-1m2f Grade 1 winner Lady Eli; with a top stable and no surprise if he features on debut; tongue-tie fitted.
runners.comment: Half-brother to connections' 7f Group 2 winner Sacred; no surprise if he features

runners.name: Garth Spirit
runners.spotlight: Struggled when 250-1 for debut at Wolverhampton (7f, AW) 18 days ago.
runners.comment: Struggled when 250-1 for debut at Wolverhampton (7f, AW) 18 days ago

runners.name: Raggaas
runners.spotlight: Fair form when fourth on both starts, latterly in six-runner Redcar novice (1m2f, good) five weeks ago; needs to improve here but is well bred and has the potential.
runners.comment: Fair form when fourth on both starts; needs to improve but has the potential

runners.name: Maid In Devon
runners.spotlight: Progressive mare who won twice over C&D this spring (good/soft) and led close home to complete her hat-trick at Chepstow (6f, good to firm) three weeks ago; could still have more to offer; respected.
runners.comment: Won twice over C&D this spring then competed hat-trick at Chepstow this month; respected

runners.name: Lahina Bay
runners.spotlight: Returned from break with disappointing run in May but placed twice since, more recently when close second of five over C&D (good to firm) a fortnight ago; can go well from the front again but others appeal more.
runners.comment: Close second of five over C&D this month; should go well again but others appeal more

runners.name: Secret Oath
runners.spotlight: Unexposed filly who made the frame in all three qualifying races, most recently when second in Chester maiden (7f, good) on seasonal/stable debut a fortnight ago; drops back in trip for handicap debut; probably still has potential.
runners.comment: Second in 7f Chester maiden on seasonal/stable debut; back in trip for handicap debut

runners.name: Liosa
runners.spotlight: Came good for current stable at third attempt, with quite stylish success at Ripon (6f, good) last month; still on good mark after recent 4lb rise and this stiffer track ought to suit him; good chance.
runners.comment: Won in good style at Ripon last month and still looks well treated after 4lb rise

runners.name: The Caribbean
runners.spotlight: Didn't find much after travelling strongly at Newbury (6f, good to firm) last month but that was his first run since February and he's on a good mark if the outing brought him on.
runners.comment: Travelled well at Newbury last month, after a break; player if that run brought him on

runners.name: Red Snapper
runners.spotlight: Runner-up twice this spring (5.7f/5f) but form has dipped on last two outings; needs to be perked up by switch from usual cheekpieces to first-time blinkers, and to prove himself on fast ground (only win came on heavy).
runners.comment: Second twice this spring (5.7f/5f) but form has dipped on last two outings; new headgear

runners.name: May Encounter
runners.spotlight: A maiden after nine starts but all three runs this season have been respectable, and she appeared not to use her energy efficiently when a weakening sixth at Leicester (6f, good to firm) last time; hooded for first time here; enters calculations.
runners.comment: Recent efforts have been respectable and she may be aided by the new hood here

runners.name: The Coffee Pod
runners.spotlight: Spoiled chance by refusing to settle on seasonal/stable but this month's midfield finish at Newbury (6f, good to firm) was more encouraging; has slipped to a dangerous mark and should now be approaching concert pitch.
runners.comment: Ran okay at Newbury this month; should be approaching concert pitch for third run of year

runners.name: Cici's Secret
runners.spotlight: Displayed some promise in three 2yo maiden/novice races last summer (5.7f-6f) but this seasonal/stable/handicap debut comes after a one-year absence, and she's entitled to benefit from the outing.
runners.comment: Dispayed some 2yo promise but makes stable/handicap debut after one-year absence

runners.name: Thunderous Love
runners.spotlight: Dual C&D winner, more recently in this race a year ago (good to firm); has questions to answer after some below-par recent efforts but is too well handicapped to rule out.
runners.comment: Well below best lately but won this race off 8lb higher in 2025; can't be ruled out

runners.name: Queen's Companion
runners.spotlight: Battled well to prevail in bunch finish at Newbury (1m2f, good to firm) this month, opening account at fifth attempt; only 2lb higher and still unexposed over this trip; ought to make her presence felt again.
runners.comment: Battled well to prevail in bunch finish at Newbury this month; remains unexposed over 1m2f
runners.owner: HM The King & HM The Queen

runners.name: Orchard
runners.spotlight: Scored over 1m on Polytrack in May and placed twice behind same progressive rival over that trip on turf at Ffos Las last month; benefits from Mason Paetel's useful 5lb claim here and shapes as though well worth a crack at 1m2f; might be the answer.
runners.comment: Placed twice over 1m last month, shaping as though well worth a crack at 1m2f

runners.name: Sudbury Hill
runners.spotlight: Easily won three-runner juvenile hurdle last month but reverts to the Flat after odds-on defeat six days later; will be suited by the trip/ground here and is probably on a workable mark but a couple of the others have less to prove; sports first-time cheekpieces.
runners.comment: Won small-field juvenile hurdle last month; back on Flat after odds-on defeat; headgear on

runners.name: Double Red
runners.spotlight: Posted career-best performance when winning on Poytrack at Lingfield (1m2f) in April, after a break, but subsequent turf form has been underwhelming and he's still on a fairly tough mark; cheekpieces refitted in bid to perk him up.
runners.comment: Won on AW in April, after a break, but subsequent turf form has been underwhelming

races.race_name: Madar Corporation 'Proud To Support Salisbury' Handicap

runners.name: Royal Poetry
runners.spotlight: Suited by step up in trip when keeping on well for clearcut success at Doncaster (1m4f, good to firm) last week ago and now 2-7; open to further progress over this distance; likely contender.
runners.comment: Clearcut winner when upped to 1m4f one week ago; now 2-7; can progress again
runners.owner: Exors Of The Late Sheikh Mohammed Obaid

runners.name: Rossa Raheen
runners.spotlight: Denied clear run before keeping on well to go close on handicap debut at Newbury (1m2f, good) in May and, after struggling on soft ground, again ran well when fourth over that C&D (good to firm) three weeks ago; upped in trip here; must be considered.
runners.comment: Has twice run well in 1m2f Newbury handicaps this season; big player over this new trip

runners.name: Captain Cairney
runners.spotlight: Runner-up on two of his three starts this season, losing out by only a neck after game attempt to make all at Chepstow (1m4f, good to firm) this month; moves up from 0-60 grade today, though.
runners.comment: Nearly made all at Chepstow this month but moves up from 0-60 grade today
runners.owner: J O'Mulloy And W R Muir

runners.name: Notable Charm
runners.spotlight: Unexposed after only four runs but was just a respectable fourth of six in 0-55 grade on last month's handicap debut at Chepstow (1m2f, good to firm) and is effectively 1lb higher from out of the weights here; needs combination of new trip and first-time cheekpieces needs to prompt improvement.
runners.comment: Just a respectable fourth of six on handicap debut; up in trip/grade with cheekpieces on

runners.name: Traveling Man
runners.spotlight: May have been flattered by proximity when third of six in steadily run Redcar novice (1m2f, good) last month and has since finished last in a Yarmouth maiden over that trip; however, this well-bred gelding is open to improvement in handicaps.
runners.comment: Showed uninspiring form in 1m2f maiden/novice races but may improve in handicaps
runners.owner: P Hickman And Lord Lloyd Webber

runners.name: Virtue Diligence
runners.spotlight: Down the field on first two starts (1m/1m2f) but fared better when third of seven here (1m2f, good to firm) last month, albeit no threat to front pair; should have more improvement to come in handicaps.
runners.comment: Improved form when third in 1m2f maiden here last month; now makes handicap debut

runners.name: Escape Magic
runners.spotlight: 2-2 since switched to handicaps this season, with both wins gained over 7f on fast ground; raised just 1lb for latter success and the form has been well advertised by the runner-up since; hard to beat if stamina holds out over this new trip.
runners.comment: 2-2 since switched to handicaps this season; upped from 7f today; strong claims

runners.name: Arvana Belle
runners.spotlight: Began season with three disappointing runs but was seeemingly aided by first-time blinkers (retained) when third at Leicester (7f, good to firm) 11 days ago, when she was denied a clear run close home and might have been unlucky; another 1lb lower for first attempt at 1m; one to consider.
runners.comment: Back in form and might have been unlucky when third in new blinkers this month (7f)

runners.name: Desert Charm
runners.spotlight: Came good with two narrow wins last month in Chepstow handicap (1m, good) and Lingfield classified (7.6f, good to firm); may need to find a bit extra but is respected in her current mood.
runners.comment: Came good with two wins last month (1m/7.6f); respected in current mood

runners.name: Lady Of The Isles
runners.spotlight: Nine-race maiden who is yet to hit top gear after three runs in blinkers this season (1m-1m2f); slipping down the weights but needs to up her game; refitted hood is added to the blinkers.
runners.comment: Nine-race maiden who is yet to hit top gear after three runs this season

runners.name: It's Life
runners.spotlight: 0-15 under all codes and absent since well-held fourth over hurdles in October; will probably find this trip too sharp; best to look elsewhere.
runners.comment: 0-15 under all codes and absent since well-held fourth over hurdles in October

runners.name: Outrace
runners.spotlight: Dangerously handicapped on old form but looked out of sorts during five-race turf/AW spell from August to January; gelded in March; needs to have been revitalised by 203-day break.
runners.comment: Looked out of sorts during five-race turf/AW spell from August to January; back from break

runners.name: Counting Stars
runners.spotlight: On target four times in her last seven outings; scored in the Acorn Stakes last month; jockey's C&D record from low draws is useful and expected to be in the thick of things.
runners.comment: Jockey's C&D record from low draws is useful and could figure.

runners.name: Always A Runner
runners.spotlight: Behind Counting Stars when beaten just under 4l to finish second in the Acorn Stakes last month; has won three of her four career runs and landed the Kentucky Oaks three months ago; major player.
runners.comment: Has to be feared; placed in the Acorn Stakes last month.
runners.owner: Douglas Scharbauer & Three Chimneys Farm LLC

runners.name: La Rascasse
runners.spotlight: Bids to pull off a hat-trick; won a black type by just over 2l at Churchill Downs last month; this is the only ride on the card for Axel Concepcion; easy enough to take on despite that win last time
runners.comment: Despite that Churchill Downs success, others have more pressing claims.

runners.name: Miss Fulton Gal
runners.spotlight: Career wins-runs record of 4-11; 15-2 winner by just over 2l at Delaware Park last month in a black type; despite that Delaware Park success, unlikely to trouble the principals; also engaged in race 7 at Monmouth Park.
runners.comment: Despite that Delaware Park success, others are preferred.
runners.owner: Trott Racing Stable, Five Sisters Farm & John Polizos

runners.name: Dandona
runners.spotlight: Missed the frame (beaten 7l into sixth) in an allowance Grade 3 at Churchill Downs two months ago; on target twice in her last five outings.
runners.comment: Beaten 7l two months ago; has chalked up two wins from her last five.

runners.name: Measure
runners.spotlight: Went down by 1l behind Directive last month in an allowance optional claimer.
runners.comment: Went down by 1l behind Directive last month in an allowance optional claimer.
runners.owner: Gary Barber, Bridlewood Farm & Eclipse Thoroughbred Partners

runners.name: Directive
runners.spotlight: Landed a narrow success in an allowance optional claimer last month; aiming to complete a hat-trick and has made an impressive start to her career with two wins from three starts; in the mix.
runners.comment: Shouldn't be too far away; narrow winner last month.

runners.name: Zany
runners.spotlight: Behind Always A Runner at Churchill Downs when sixth of 13 in the Kentucky Oaks in May; winner of three of her five runs to date; wears first-time blinkers; warrants consideration as has some big wins on the CV; also engaged in race 7 at Monmouth Park.
runners.comment: Shouldn't be too far away as has some big wins on the CV.

runners.name: Nycon
runners.spotlight: No impression when fourth of eight in April, finishing well behind reopposing Always A Runner at Aqueduct in an allowance Grade 3; workout history raises concerns this race may be needed so not hard to turn elsewhere; was due to run at Saratoga Friday.
runners.comment: Not hard to turn elsewhere as has not been seen doing much trackwork recently.

runners.name: Listenupshance
runners.owner: Great Friends Stables & Run Fast Racing

runners.name: Dr. Venkman
runners.owner: Alipony Racing, Dan J Agnew Et Al

runners.name: Maximum Bourbon
runners.owner: Agave Racing Stable, Evan Trommer & Rockin Robin Racing

runners.name: Cornucopian
runners.owner: Bashor Racing LLC, Front Row Club Et Al

runners.name: Cosmic Crusader
runners.spotlight: Resuming (32-weeks). Ex Michael Grantham in WA. Took his game to another level winning the Northerly Stakes last prep. Excellent first up record. Soft jump-out here 1/7. Leading contender.

runners.name: Winnasedge
runners.spotlight: Annexed the (Bm84) at Caulfield 27 Jun. Rallied powerfully from midfield to salute this venue. See no reason he can't bring up a hat-trick of wins.
runners.owner: R A Holburt, B R Holburt Et Al

runners.name: Miraval Rose
runners.spotlight: Went back, closed intently this track off long break. Will be better for the outing. Must be considered.
runners.owner: D J Oliphant, P J Salter Et Al

runners.name: Zou Sensation
runners.spotlight: Let-up (49-days). Sent out $13 when unable to threaten at Eagle Farm when second-up. Sharper now and can make his presence felt with even breaks.
runners.owner: Bennett Racing Pty Ltd (N Bennett), D Hardie Et Al

runners.name: Watchme Win
runners.spotlight: Knuckled down with purpose in choppy conditions here last time. Key player.
runners.owner: A J Hehir, D W Rasheed Et Al

runners.name: Recommendation
runners.spotlight: Great run at Flemington 20 Jun. Put in some good work late this course. Very fit and not out of this.
runners.owner: N S Psaltis, Mrs G C Psaltis Et Al

runners.name: Aztec Ruler
runners.spotlight: First-up (23-weeks). Ex S V Vahala in Victoria. Last win was 23 Nov 2024. 1st & 4th at recent jump-outs. Place claims preferred.
runners.owner: A T Biacsi, D Angely Et Al

runners.name: Samangu
runners.spotlight: Midfield and worked home solidly in rain affected going at Flemington second-up. Others with greater appeal.
runners.owner: D M D B Syndicate, Grahame Begg Racing Et Al

runners.name: Title Fighter
runners.spotlight: Raced in back half and was never in a position to mount a serious challenge this track. Needs to recapture form.

runners.name: Brat Pack
runners.owner: Alex G Campbell Jr Thoroughbreds LLC

runners.name: Aretha
runners.owner: X-Men Racing V LLC & Madaket Stables LLC

runners.name: Empty Handed
runners.owner: Discovery Racing, Goldie Stables & Tom McCrocklin

runners.name: Bandiagara
runners.owner: Madaket Stables LLC, Kisber Racing et al
